        log "功能测试结果:"
        log "  接口: $(echo "$HEALTH_JSON" | grep -o '"interface":"[^"]*"' | cut -d'"' -f4)"
        log "  质量分数: $(echo "$HEALTH_JSON" | grep -o '"quality_score":[0-9.]*' | cut -d: -f2)"
        log "  RTT: $(echo "$HEALTH_JSON" | grep -o '"rtt_ms":[0-9-]*' | cut -d: -f2) ms"
        log "  RSSI: $(echo "$HEALTH_JSON" | grep -o '"rssi_dbm":[0-9-]*' | cut -d: -f2) dBm"
    fi

    FAIL_COUNT=$(printf '%s' "$FUNC_RESULT" | grep -oE 'FAIL: [0-9]+' | grep -oE '[0-9]+' | tail -1 || true)
    if [ "${TEST_EXIT}" -ne 0 ] || [ "${FAIL_COUNT:-0}" -gt 0 ]; then
        fail "开发板测试失败（退出码 ${TEST_EXIT}，FAIL=${FAIL_COUNT:-未知}）"
    fi
    pass "测试完成"
else
    info "跳过测试"
fi

# ============================================================
log ""
log "=============================================="
pass "全部完成"
log "=============================================="

223	    scp "${ROOT}/tools/com.example.WeakNet.conf" "${BOARD}:/tmp/com.example.WeakNet.conf" 2>/dev/null
224	    # S5：Edge 预共享令牌通过安全通道渲染并直接安装到 /etc/weaknet/config.yaml（0600），
225	    # 绝不写入 /tmp（消除世界可读窗口），且 token 绝不进入远程命令 argv（ps 可见风险）。
226	    EDGE_TOKEN_FILE="${ROOT}/secrets/edge_token"
227	    [[ -s "${EDGE_TOKEN_FILE}" ]] || fail "缺少 ${EDGE_TOKEN_FILE}（edge 上行预共享令牌），先创建该文件再部署"
228	    EDGE_TOKEN="$(tr -d '[:space:]' < "${EDGE_TOKEN_FILE}")"
229	    [[ "${EDGE_TOKEN}" =~ ^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$ ]] || fail "secrets/edge_token 含非法字符（仅允许 [A-Za-z0-9_-]）"
230	    RENDERED_CONFIG="$(mktemp "${ROOT}/.ci-config-XXXXXX.yaml")"
231	    chmod 0600 "${RENDERED_CONFIG}"
232	    sed "s|^  token: \"\"$|  token: \"${EDGE_TOKEN}\"|" config.yaml > "${RENDERED_CONFIG}"
233	    ssh "${BOARD}" "sudo mkdir -p /etc/weaknet && sudo install -m 0600 /dev/stdin /etc/weaknet/config.yaml" < "${RENDERED_CONFIG}" || {
234	        shred -u "${RENDERED_CONFIG}" 2>/dev/null || rm -f "${RENDERED_CONFIG}"
235	        fail "edge token 注入板端失败（stdin → /etc/weaknet/config.yaml）"
236	    }
237	    shred -u "${RENDERED_CONFIG}" 2>/dev/null || rm -f "${RENDERED_CONFIG}"
238	    pass "edge token 已安全注入 /etc/weaknet/config.yaml（0600，不进 argv/tmp）"
239	
240	    # 客户端动态库安装到系统路径，供 weaknet-cli 链接（服务端走 unit 内 LD_LIBRARY_PATH）
241	    scp "${DIST_DIR}/client/lib/libweaknet.so" "${BOARD}:/tmp/libweaknet.so" 2>/dev/null
242	    ssh "${BOARD}" "sudo cp /tmp/weaknet-server.service /etc/systemd/system/weaknet-server.service && \
243	        sudo cp /tmp/com.example.WeakNet.conf /etc/dbus-1/system.d/com.example.WeakNet.conf && \
244	        sudo cp /tmp/libweaknet.so /usr/local/lib/libweaknet.so && sudo ldconfig && \
245	        sudo chmod o+rx /home/radxa/weaknet/data 2>/dev/null || true && \
246	        sudo systemctl daemon-reload && sudo systemctl reload dbus 2>/dev/null || true; \
247	        sudo systemctl enable weaknet-server"
248	    # 注意：此处刻意不 restart——重启由 adopt 在 current 翻转之后执行，
249	    # 否则新 unit（current/server 路径）在布局未就位时会拉起失败。
250	
251	    # OTA 布局迁移/切换（板端重启唯一入口）：暂存产物 → releases/${VERSION}
252	    # →（首次）旧扁平布局归档 legacy-flat → 原子翻转 current + 兼容软链
253	    # → 重启 → 健康窗口（失败自动回滚上一版）→ .committed 转正。
254	    scp "${ROOT}/tools/weaknet-local-update.sh" "${BOARD}:/tmp/weaknet-local-update.sh" 2>/dev/null
255	    ssh "${BOARD}" "sudo install -m 0755 /tmp/weaknet-local-update.sh /home/radxa/weaknet/weaknet-local-update.sh && \
256	        sudo WEAKNET_ROOT=/home/radxa/weaknet /home/radxa/weaknet/weaknet-local-update.sh adopt /home/radxa/weaknet/.deploy-staging ${VERSION}" \
257	        || fail "adopt 失败（布局迁移/健康窗口未通过，已自动回滚）——依据上方输出排查，必要时 sudo weaknet-cli update rollback"
258	    pass "部署完成（releases/${VERSION} 已转正）"
259	
260	    scp "${ROOT}/tools/weaknet-test-full.sh" "${BOARD}:/home/radxa/weaknet/weaknet-test-full.sh" 2>/dev/null
261	    ssh "${BOARD}" "chmod +x /home/radxa/weaknet/weaknet-test-full.sh" 2>/dev/null
262	    pass "部署完成"
263	else
264	    info "跳过部署"
265	fi
266	
267	# ============================================================
268	# Step 4: 开发板测试
269	# ============================================================
270	if [ "$SKIP_TEST" = false ]; then
271	    log ""
272	    log "===== Step 4: 开发板测试 ====="
273	
274	    # 上传测试脚本
275	    scp "${ROOT}/tools/weaknet-test-full.sh" "${BOARD}:/home/radxa/weaknet/weaknet-test-full.sh" 2>/dev/null
276	    ssh "${BOARD}" "chmod +x /home/radxa/weaknet/weaknet-test-full.sh" 2>/dev/null
277	
278	    # 运行测试（weaknet-test-full.sh 以 FAIL 条数作为退出码）
279	    #  - 完整输出存报告，控制台只显示前 80 行（截断只是显示，不再是取证上限）
280	    #  - 退出码必须捕获：旧写法 `|| true` 会吞掉失败，然后无条件打印
281	    #    "测试完成"，冒烟挂了 CI 也报成功——与构建失败同级的发布可信度缺陷
282	    FUNC_RESULT=""
283	    TEST_EXIT=0
284	    FUNC_RESULT=$(ssh -t "${BOARD}" "sudo /home/radxa/weaknet/weaknet-test-full.sh" 2>&1) || TEST_EXIT=$?
285	    printf '%s\n' "$FUNC_RESULT" >> "$REPORT"
286	    # head 提前退出会让 printf 吃 SIGPIPE(141)；pipefail + set -e 会因此误报失败，
287	    # 所以显示用的管道必须放行（报告里已有完整输出，截断只是显示）
288	    printf '%s\n' "$FUNC_RESULT" | head -80 || true
289	
290	    # 解析结果
291	    # 显示用解析：grep 无匹配时不能让 set -e 把已通过的测试判成失败
292	    HEALTH_JSON=$(echo "$FUNC_RESULT" | grep "健康检查结果" | head -1 | sed 's/.*: //' || true)
293	    if [ -n "$HEALTH_JSON" ]; then
294	        log ""
295	        log "功能测试结果:"
296	        log "  接口: $(echo "$HEALTH_JSON" | grep -o '"interface":"[^"]*"' | cut -d'"' -f4)"
297	        log "  质量分数: $(echo "$HEALTH_JSON" | grep -o '"quality_score":[0-9.]*' | cut -d: -f2)"
298	        log "  RTT: $(echo "$HEALTH_JSON" | grep -o '"rtt_ms":[0-9-]*' | cut -d: -f2) ms"
299	        log "  RSSI: $(echo "$HEALTH_JSON" | grep -o '"rssi_dbm":[0-9-]*' | cut -d: -f2) dBm"
300	    fi
301	
302	    # 双保险：退出码 + 输出里的 FAIL 计数
303	    FAIL_COUNT=$(printf '%s' "$FUNC_RESULT" | grep -oE 'FAIL: [0-9]+' | grep -oE '[0-9]+' | tail -1 || true)
304	    if [ "${TEST_EXIT}" -ne 0 ] || [ "${FAIL_COUNT:-0}" -gt 0 ]; then
305	        fail "开发板测试失败（退出码 ${TEST_EXIT}，FAIL=${FAIL_COUNT:-未知}）"
306	    fi
307	    pass "测试完成"
308	else
309	    info "跳过测试"
310	fi
311	
312	# ============================================================
313	log ""
314	log "=============================================="
315	pass "全部完成"
316	log "=============================================="
317	
</system-reminder>

[Unit]
Description=WeakNet Network Monitor Server
After=network-online.target dbus.service
Wants=network-online.target

[Service]
Type=simple
# 路径经 current 软链接寻址（OTA 布局：current -> releases/<version>）。
# 翻转 current 是原子的，重启后即运行新版；历史文档路径
# /home/radxa/weaknet/server/bin/* 由板端兼容软链（server -> current/server）
# 继续保持有效。bpf_obj 等配置中的相对路径随 WorkingDirectory 解析到新版目录。
WorkingDirectory=/home/radxa/weaknet/current/server
ExecStart=/home/radxa/weaknet/current/server/bin/weaknet-dbus-server --config /etc/weaknet/config.yaml
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=5
Environment=LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/usr/local/lib
Environment=WEAKNET_DATA_DIR=/home/radxa/weaknet/data
Environment=WEAKNET_ROOT=/home/radxa/weaknet
User=root
Group=root
# eBPF 探针加载/挂载需要 CAP_BPF + CAP_PERFMON（内核 5.8+），
# 网络诊断（ping raw socket / netlink）需要 CAP_NET_RAW + CAP_NET_ADMIN
#
# CAP_DAC_OVERRIDE 是必需的，不是可选加固项：服务以 root 运行，但
# data/ 目录属于 radxa:radxa 且权限位为 0700/0750 —— root 既不是属主也
# 不在属组，被当作 "other" 拒绝。没有 DAC_OVERRIDE 时，root 无法创建
# data/network-epoch，连 history.db 都会 "unable to open database file"，
# 于是本地历史持久化静默失效（日志里只有一行 failed to open，其余功能照常）。
AmbientCapabilities=CAP_NET_RAW CAP_NET_ADMIN CAP_BPF CAP_PERFMON CAP_DAC_OVERRIDE
CapabilityBoundingSet=CAP_NET_RAW CAP_NET_ADMIN CAP_BPF CAP_PERFMON CAP_DAC_OVERRIDE
NoNewPrivileges=false
LimitNOFILE=65536

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# ============================================================================
# weaknet-local-update.sh — OTA Phase 1 板端本地升级执行体
#
# 职责：解包校验 → 版本单调检查 → 原子切换 current 软链接 → 重启服务 →
#       健康窗口 → 转正（.committed）或自动回滚上一版本。
#
# 用法：
#   weaknet-local-update.sh status
#   weaknet-local-update.sh verify <pkg.tar.zst|release-dir>
#   weaknet-local-update.sh apply <pkg.tar.zst> [--allow-downgrade]
#                                    [--commit]        # = --no-health，跳过健康窗口直接转正
#                                    [--no-health] [--health-timeout N]
#   weaknet-local-update.sh rollback [--to <version>] [--health-timeout N]
#   weaknet-local-update.sh adopt <staged-dir> <version> [--no-health]
#   weaknet-local-update.sh package <dist-dir> <version> <out.tar.zst>
#
# 环境变量：
#   WEAKNET_ROOT              安装根（默认 /home/radxa/weaknet）
#   WEAKNET_UPDATE_DRYRUN=1   跳过 systemctl/busctl（本地沙盒演练用）
#   WEAKNET_RELEASE_PRIV      发布私钥 PEM（package 时签名；不设则不签）
#   WEAKNET_RELEASE_PUB       板端验签公钥（apply 时验签；不设则告警放行）
#
# 板端布局（升级建立后）：
#   $ROOT/releases/<version>/{server,client,lib,...,VERSION,manifest.sha256,.committed}
#   $ROOT/current -> releases/<version>          # 原子翻转点
#   $ROOT/{server,client,lib,...} -> current/*   # 兼容软链，历史路径不变
#   $ROOT/data/ 与 $ROOT/config/ 升级永不触碰
#
# 设计约束：
#   - apply/rollback 会重启 weaknet-server，必须 root 执行（status/verify/package 不需要）
#   - data/ 下 5 个状态文件（history.db / network-epoch / wireless-uplink-state /
#     runtime-overrides.bin / config_txn_state）与 /etc/weaknet/config.yaml 全程只读
#   - 版本比较用 dpkg --compare-versions（Debian 基线自带，数字感知）
#   - 改了 ActionRegistry/白名单的版本，发布前必须同步云端目录评审
#     （docs/网关动作目录版本契约.md，fail-closed 防线）
# ============================================================================
set -euo pipefail

ROOT="${WEAKNET_ROOT:-/home/radxa/weaknet}"
RELEASES="$ROOT/releases"
CURRENT_LINK="$ROOT/current"
SERVICE="weaknet-server"
BUS_DEST="com.example.WeakNet"
BUS_PATH="/com/example/WeakNet"
BUS_IFACE="com.example.WeakNet"
HEALTH_POLL_S="${HEALTH_POLL_S:-5}"
HEALTH_OK_NEEDED=3
COMPAT_ENTRIES=(server client lib edge_network_rag.py network_knowledge_base.py)

RED='\033[0;31m'; GREEN='\033[0;32m'; YELLOW='\033[1;33m'; CYAN='\033[0;36m'; NC='\033[0m'
# 诊断信息一律走 stderr：stdout 只留可被命令替换捕获的数据（版本号/目录路径/JSON）
pass()  { echo -e "${GREEN}✅ $1${NC}" >&2; }
fail()  { echo -e "${RED}❌ $1${NC}" >&2; exit 1; }
info()  { echo -e "${CYAN}ℹ️  $1${NC}" >&2; }
warn()  { echo -e "${YELLOW}⚠️  $1${NC}" >&2; }

DRYRUN="${WEAKNET_UPDATE_DRYRUN:-0}"
require_root() {
    [ "$DRYRUN" = "1" ] && return 0
    [ "$(id -u)" = "0" ] || fail "此命令需要 root 权限（sudo 执行）"
}

# ---- 通用工具 ---------------------------------------------------------------

current_version() {
    # current -> releases/<ver>；无链接/非法版本名返回空
    local t
    t="$(readlink "$CURRENT_LINK" 2>/dev/null || true)"
    [ -z "$t" ] && return 0
    t="${t##*/}"
    if [[ "$t" =~ ^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$ ]]; then
        echo "$t"
    fi
}

valid_version() { [[ "$1" =~ ^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$ ]]; }

# 版本策略：target >= current（数字比较）；current 为空 = 首次安装放行
version_allowed() {  # $1=current $2=target $3=allow_downgrade(0/1)
    local cur="$1" tgt="$2" allow="${3:-0}"
    valid_version "$tgt" || return 1
    [ -z "$cur" ] && return 0
    valid_version "$cur" || return 1
    dpkg --compare-versions "$tgt" ge "$cur" && return 0
    [ "$allow" = "1" ] && return 0
    return 1
}

atomic_symlink() {  # $1=linkname(相对 releases/) $2=linkpath(绝对)
    ln -sfn "$1" "$2.tmp.$$"
    mv -Tf "$2.tmp.$$" "$2"
}

# current 翻转后维护兼容软链：$ROOT/{server,client,...} -> current/<name>
refresh_compat_links() {
    local e
    for e in "${COMPAT_ENTRIES[@]}"; do
        if [ -e "$CURRENT_LINK/$e" ] || [ -L "$CURRENT_LINK/$e" ]; then
            # 目标真实存在才建链；已有同名真目录（旧扁平布局残留）时跳过并告警
            if [ -e "$ROOT/$e" ] && [ ! -L "$ROOT/$e" ]; then
                warn "跳过兼容软链 $e：$ROOT/$e 是真实目录（旧布局残留），请人工确认"
                continue
            fi
            atomic_symlink "current/$e" "$ROOT/$e"
        fi
    done
}

svc_cmd() {  # systemctl 包装（DRYRUN 下视为成功）
    if [ "$DRYRUN" = "1" ]; then return 0; fi
    systemctl "$@"
}

bus_call() {  # busctl 只读调用包装；返回 0=成功
    [ "$DRYRUN" = "1" ] && return 0
    busctl --system call "$BUS_DEST" "$BUS_PATH" "$BUS_IFACE" "$1" >/dev/null 2>&1
}

# 健康窗口：服务 active + HealthCheck/GetEbpfMonitorHealth 可达 +
# GetUpdateStatus 报告的 installed_version 等于期望版本，连续
# HEALTH_OK_NEEDED 次全过才算健康；总超时 $1（秒）。$2=期望版本（可空）
health_window() {
    local timeout="${1:-120}" expect_ver="${2:-}"
    [ "$DRYRUN" = "1" ] && return 0
    local deadline=$(( $(date +%s) + timeout ))
    local streak=0
    while [ "$(date +%s)" -lt "$deadline" ]; do
        local ok=0
        if [ "$(systemctl is-active "$SERVICE" 2>/dev/null || true)" = "active" ] \
           && bus_call HealthCheck \
           && bus_call GetEbpfMonitorHealth; then
            # GetUpdateStatus 必须报告目标版本已就位（防"健康但跑在旧版"假绿灯）
            local st
            st="$(busctl --system call "$BUS_DEST" "$BUS_PATH" "$BUS_IFACE" GetUpdateStatus 2>/dev/null || true)"
            st="${st//\\/}"
            if [ -z "$expect_ver" ] || grep -q "\"installed_version\":\"$expect_ver\"" <<<"$st"; then
                ok=1
            fi
        fi
        if [ "$ok" = "1" ]; then
            streak=$((streak + 1))
            if [ "$streak" -ge "$HEALTH_OK_NEEDED" ]; then
                pass "健康窗口通过（连续 ${streak} 次探针全绿）"
                return 0
            fi
        else
            streak=0
        fi
        sleep "$HEALTH_POLL_S"
    done
    return 1
}

# 翻转 + 重启 + 健康 + 转正/回滚。
# $1=target版本 $2=prev版本(可空) $3=health_timeout $4=同版本旧副本目录(可空，失败时恢复)
# 成功退出 0；健康失败回滚成功退出 2；回滚失败退出 3
flip_restart_commit() {
    local target="$1" prev="${2:-}" htimeout="${3:-120}" old_dir="${4:-}"

    atomic_symlink "releases/$target" "$CURRENT_LINK"
    refresh_compat_links
    svc_cmd daemon-reload || true
    svc_cmd restart "$SERVICE" || warn "restart 返回非零（继续观察健康窗口）"

    if health_window "$htimeout" "$target"; then
        touch "$RELEASES/$target/.committed"
        # 转正后才清理同版本旧副本（.$ver.old.*）；其他历史版本保留为回滚目标
        rm -rf "$RELEASES"/."$target".old.* 2>/dev/null || true
        pass "升级完成并转正：releases/${target}"
        return 0
    fi

    warn "健康窗口未通过，自动回滚"
    # 同版本重装失败：先恢复旧副本内容，再把 current 指回去
    if [ -n "$old_dir" ] && [ -d "$old_dir" ]; then
        rm -rf "$RELEASES/$target"
        mv "$old_dir" "$RELEASES/$target"
        warn "已恢复同版本旧副本内容"
    fi
    if [ -n "$prev" ] && [ -d "$RELEASES/$prev" ]; then
        atomic_symlink "releases/$prev" "$CURRENT_LINK"
        refresh_compat_links
        svc_cmd restart "$SERVICE" || true
        if health_window 60 "$prev"; then
            fail "新版本 ${target} 健康失败，已回滚到 ${prev}（exit 2，新版本未转正）"
        fi
        fail "新版本 ${target} 健康失败且回滚后 ${prev} 也不健康（exit 3，需人工介入）"
    fi
    fail "新版本 ${target} 健康失败且无可回滚的上一版本（exit 3，需人工介入）"
}

# 校验一个 release 目录：manifest 逐文件 sha256 + VERSION 合法。$1=dir
# 成功时 stdout 只输出版本号（诊断信息走 stderr）；失败直接 fail 退出
verify_release_dir() {
    local dir="$1"
    [ -f "$dir/VERSION" ] || fail "release 缺少 VERSION 文件：$dir"
    local ver; ver="$(tr -d '[:space:]' < "$dir/VERSION")"
    valid_version "$ver" || fail "VERSION 内容非法：$ver"
    if [ -f "$dir/manifest.sha256" ]; then
        # sha256sum -c 的 "file: FAILED" 行走 stdout，必须丢弃——否则会被
        # 命令替换方捕获进版本变量（实测踩过：ver 变成 "xxx: FAILED"）
        (cd "$dir" && sha256sum --quiet -c manifest.sha256 >/dev/null 2>&1) \
            || fail "manifest 完整性校验失败：$dir"
        info "manifest.sha256 全量校验通过（$(grep -c '^[0-9a-f]' "$dir/manifest.sha256" || true) 个文件）"
    else
        warn "release 无 manifest.sha256（开发机 adopt 场景可接受；正式包必须携带）"
    fi
    echo "$ver"
}

# 签名验证（占位→真实）：公钥存在才强制；无公钥告警放行（Phase 2 接云侧发布密钥）
verify_signature() {  # $1=pkg 文件
    local pkg="$1" pub="${WEAKNET_RELEASE_PUB:-$ROOT/config/release_pub.pem}"
    if [ ! -f "$pub" ]; then
        warn "未配置发布公钥（$pub），跳过签名校验——Phase 2 接入云侧发布密钥后将强制"
        return 0
    fi
    [ -f "$pkg.sig" ] || fail "已配置发布公钥但缺少签名文件 $pkg.sig（fail-closed）"
    openssl pkeyutl -verify -pubin -inkey "$pub" -rawin \
        -in "$pkg" -sigfile "$pkg.sig" >/dev/null 2>&1 \
        || fail "包签名校验失败：$pkg"
    pass "Ed25519 签名校验通过"
}

# 解包 + 校验 + 版本策略 → 输出 staging 目录路径。$1=pkg $2=allow_downgrade
stage_package() {
    local pkg="$1" allow="${2:-0}"
    [ -f "$pkg" ] || fail "升级包不存在：$pkg"
    verify_signature "$pkg"
    local cur; cur="$(current_version)"
    local staging="$RELEASES/.staging.$$"
    rm -rf "$staging"; mkdir -p "$staging"
    case "$pkg" in
        *.tar.zst|*.tzst) tar --zstd -xf "$pkg" -C "$staging" ;;
        *.tar.gz|*.tgz)   tar -zxf "$pkg" -C "$staging" ;;
        *.tar)            tar -xf "$pkg" -C "$staging" ;;
        *) rm -rf "$staging"; fail "不支持的包格式：$pkg（需 tar.zst/tar.gz/tar）" ;;
    esac
    local ver
    # 显式接住校验失败：函数内的 fail 在命令替换子 shell 里只体现为非零退出码，
    # 不加 || 会穿透 set -e 继续执行（实测踩过）
    ver="$(verify_release_dir "$staging")" || { rm -rf "$staging"; exit 1; }
    if ! version_allowed "$cur" "$ver" "$allow"; then
        rm -rf "$staging"
        fail "版本策略拒绝：current=${cur:-无} → target=${ver}（降级需 --allow-downgrade）"
    fi
    echo "$staging"
}

install_self_script() {  # $1=新 release 目录：自更新脚本到稳定路径
    local rel="$1"
    if [ -f "$rel/weaknet-local-update.sh" ] && [ "$(readlink -f "$rel/weaknet-local-update.sh")" != "$(readlink -f "$0")" ]; then
        install -m 0755 "$rel/weaknet-local-update.sh" "$ROOT/weaknet-local-update.sh.new"
        mv -f "$ROOT/weaknet-local-update.sh.new" "$ROOT/weaknet-local-update.sh"
        info "升级脚本已自更新到 $ROOT/weaknet-local-update.sh"
    fi
}

# ---- 子命令 -----------------------------------------------------------------

cmd_status() {
    local cur; cur="$(current_version)"
    echo "root:            $ROOT"
    if [ -n "$cur" ]; then
        echo "layout:          releases"
        echo "installed:       $cur"
        echo "committed:       $([ -f "$RELEASES/$cur/.committed" ] && echo yes || echo no)"
    else
        echo "layout:          flat（未迁移，升级脚本首次 apply/adopt 后建立 releases 布局）"
        echo "installed:       unmanaged"
    fi
    local prev; prev="$(cat "$RELEASES/.previous" 2>/dev/null || true)"
    echo "previous:        ${prev:-无}"
    echo "releases:"
    local d
    for d in "$RELEASES"/*/; do
        [ -d "$d" ] || continue
        local v; v="$(basename "$d")"
        local mark=" "
        [ -e "$CURRENT_LINK" ] && [ "$(readlink "$CURRENT_LINK")" = "releases/$v" ] && mark="*"
        [ -f "$d/.committed" ] && mark="${mark}c" || mark="${mark} "
        echo "  $mark $v"
    done
}

cmd_verify() {  # $1=pkg|dir
    local target="$1"
    [ -n "$target" ] || fail "用法：verify <pkg.tar.zst|release-dir>"
    if [ -d "$target" ]; then
        verify_release_dir "$target" >/dev/null
        pass "release 目录校验通过：$target"
    else
        local cur; cur="$(current_version)"
        local staging; staging="$(stage_package "$target" 0)" || exit 1
        local ver; ver="$(tr -d '[:space:]' < "$staging/VERSION")"
        rm -rf "$staging"
        pass "升级包校验通过：version=${ver}（current=${cur:-无}，策略允许）"
    fi
}

cmd_apply() {  # $1=pkg 其余为选项
    require_root
    local pkg="$1"; shift
    local allow=0 health=1 htimeout=120
    while [ $# -gt 0 ]; do
        case "$1" in
            --allow-downgrade) allow=1 ;;
            --commit|--no-health) health=0 ;;
            --health-timeout) htimeout="$2"; shift ;;
            *) fail "apply 未知参数：$1" ;;
        esac
        shift
    done
    [ -n "$pkg" ] || fail "用法：apply <pkg.tar.zst> [--allow-downgrade] [--commit] [--health-timeout N]"

    local cur; cur="$(current_version)"
    info "current=${cur:-无（首次/未迁移）} → 应用 $pkg"
    local staging; staging="$(stage_package "$pkg" "$allow")" || exit 1
    local ver; ver="$(tr -d '[:space:]' < "$staging/VERSION")"

    svc_cmd stop "$SERVICE" 2>/dev/null || true

    # 记录回滚指针（首次安装无 prev，写空）
    if [ -n "$cur" ]; then echo "$cur" > "$RELEASES/.previous"; else rm -f "$RELEASES/.previous"; fi

    # 目标版本目录替换（同版本幂等重装）：旧副本保留到健康窗口通过才清理
    local old_dir=""
    if [ -d "$RELEASES/$ver" ]; then
        old_dir="$RELEASES/.$ver.old.$$"
        rm -rf "$old_dir"
        mv "$RELEASES/$ver" "$old_dir"
    fi
    mv "$staging" "$RELEASES/$ver"
    install_self_script "$RELEASES/$ver"

    if [ "$health" = "0" ]; then
        atomic_symlink "releases/$ver" "$CURRENT_LINK"
        refresh_compat_links
        svc_cmd daemon-reload || true
        svc_cmd restart "$SERVICE" || warn "restart 返回非零（--commit 模式不看健康窗口）"
        touch "$RELEASES/$ver/.committed"
        [ -n "$old_dir" ] && rm -rf "$old_dir"
        warn "--commit：跳过健康窗口，已直接转正 releases/${ver}"
        return 0
    fi

    flip_restart_commit "$ver" "$cur" "$htimeout" "$old_dir"
}

cmd_rollback() {  # [--to <version>]
    require_root
    local target="" htimeout=120
    while [ $# -gt 0 ]; do
        case "$1" in
            --to) target="$2"; shift ;;
            --health-timeout) htimeout="$2"; shift ;;
            *) fail "rollback 未知参数：$1" ;;
        esac
        shift
    done
    local cur; cur="$(current_version)"
    [ -n "$cur" ] || fail "当前无 releases 布局，无法回滚"
    if [ -z "$target" ]; then
        target="$(cat "$RELEASES/.previous" 2>/dev/null || true)"
        [ -n "$target" ] || fail "无 .previous 记录，无法自动回滚；可用 --to <version> 指定"
    fi
    valid_version "$target" || fail "回滚目标版本非法：$target"
    [ -d "$RELEASES/$target" ] || fail "回滚目标不存在：releases/$target"
    [ "$target" = "$cur" ] && fail "回滚目标与当前版本相同：$cur"

    info "回滚：${cur} → ${target}"
    echo "$cur" > "$RELEASES/.previous"   # 回滚后再回滚 = 回到刚放弃的版本
    svc_cmd stop "$SERVICE" 2>/dev/null || true
    flip_restart_commit "$target" "$cur" "$htimeout"
}

cmd_adopt() {  # $1=staged-dir $2=version 其余为选项
    # ci.sh 集成：接管已 rsync 到板端的产物目录，完成布局迁移 + 切换 + 健康。
    require_root
    local staged="$1" ver="$2"; shift 2
    local health=1 htimeout=120
    while [ $# -gt 0 ]; do
        case "$1" in
            --commit|--no-health) health=0 ;;
            --health-timeout) htimeout="$2"; shift ;;
            *) fail "adopt 未知参数：$1" ;;
        esac
        shift
    done
    [ -d "$staged" ] || fail "staged 目录不存在：$staged"
    valid_version "$ver" || fail "版本号非法：$ver（需 X.Y.Z）"
    mkdir -p "$RELEASES"

    # 首次迁移：旧扁平布局整体归档为 releases/legacy-flat（含 VERSION 占位）
    local cur; cur="$(current_version)"
    if [ -z "$cur" ] && [ -d "$ROOT/server" ] && [ ! -L "$ROOT/server" ]; then
        info "检测到旧扁平布局，归档为 releases/legacy-flat"
        mkdir -p "$RELEASES/legacy-flat"
        local e
        for e in server client lib edge_network_rag.py network_knowledge_base.py; do
            [ -e "$ROOT/$e" ] && [ ! -L "$ROOT/$e" ] && mv "$ROOT/$e" "$RELEASES/legacy-flat/" || true
        done
        echo "0.0.0" > "$RELEASES/legacy-flat/VERSION" 2>/dev/null || true
        touch "$RELEASES/legacy-flat/.committed"
    fi

    # staged → releases/<ver>（补 VERSION/manifest/脚本，供后续 rollback 与校验）；
    # 同版本已存在时旧副本保留到健康窗口通过才清理
    local rel="$RELEASES/$ver" old_dir=""
    if [ -d "$rel" ]; then
        old_dir="$RELEASES/.$ver.old.$$"
        rm -rf "$old_dir"
        mv "$rel" "$old_dir"
    fi
    mv "$staged" "$rel"
    echo "$ver" > "$rel/VERSION"
    [ -f "$rel/weaknet-local-update.sh" ] || install -m 0755 "$0" "$rel/weaknet-local-update.sh"
    (cd "$rel" && find . -type f ! -name manifest.sha256 ! -name .committed -print0 \
        | sed -z 's|^\./||' | sort -z | xargs -0 sha256sum > manifest.sha256)
    verify_release_dir "$rel" >/dev/null

    if [ -n "$cur" ]; then echo "$cur" > "$RELEASES/.previous"; else rm -f "$RELEASES/.previous"; fi
    install_self_script "$rel"

    if [ "$health" = "0" ]; then
        atomic_symlink "releases/$ver" "$CURRENT_LINK"
        refresh_compat_links
        svc_cmd daemon-reload || true
        svc_cmd restart "$SERVICE" || warn "restart 返回非零"
        touch "$rel/.committed"
        [ -n "$old_dir" ] && rm -rf "$old_dir"
        warn "--no-health：跳过健康窗口直接转正 releases/${ver}"
        return 0
    fi
    flip_restart_commit "$ver" "$cur" "$htimeout" "$old_dir"
}

cmd_package() {  # <dist-dir> <version> <out.tar.zst>
    local dist="$1" ver="$2" out="$3"
    [ -d "$dist" ] || fail "dist 目录不存在：$dist"
    valid_version "$ver" || fail "版本号非法：$ver（需 X.Y.Z）"
    echo "$ver" > "$dist/VERSION"
    if [ -f "$0" ]; then install -m 0755 "$0" "$dist/weaknet-local-update.sh"; fi
    (cd "$dist" && find . -type f ! -name manifest.sha256 -print0 \
        | sed -z 's|^\./||' | sort -z | xargs -0 sha256sum > manifest.sha256)
    mkdir -p "$(dirname "$out")"
    tar --zstd -cf "$out" -C "$dist" .
    if [ -n "${WEAKNET_RELEASE_PRIV:-}" ] && [ -f "${WEAKNET_RELEASE_PRIV}" ]; then
        openssl pkeyutl -sign -rawin -inkey "$WEAKNET_RELEASE_PRIV" \
            -in "$out" -sigfile "$out.sig"
        pass "已签名：$out.sig"
    else
        warn "未设 WEAKNET_RELEASE_PRIV，包未签名（Phase 1 本地信任可接受）"
    fi
    pass "打包完成：$out ($(du -h "$out" | cut -f1))"
}

# ---- 入口 -------------------------------------------------------------------

usage() { sed -n '2,30p' "$0" | sed 's/^# \{0,1\}//'; }

main() {
    local cmd="${1:-}"
    [ -n "$cmd" ] || { usage; exit 1; }
    shift || true
    case "$cmd" in
        status)   cmd_status "$@" ;;
        verify)   cmd_verify "$@" ;;
        apply)    cmd_apply "$@" ;;
        rollback) cmd_rollback "$@" ;;
        adopt)    cmd_adopt "$@" ;;
        package)  cmd_package "$@" ;;
        -h|--help|help) usage ;;
        *) usage; fail "未知命令：$cmd" ;;
    esac
}

main "$@"

175	    # 同版本重装失败：先恢复旧副本内容，再把 current 指回去
176	    if [ -n "$old_dir" ] && [ -d "$old_dir" ]; then
177	        rm -rf "$RELEASES/$target"
178	        mv "$old_dir" "$RELEASES/$target"
179	        warn "已恢复同版本旧副本内容"
180	    fi
181	    if [ -n "$prev" ] && [ -d "$RELEASES/$prev" ]; then
182	        atomic_symlink "releases/$prev" "$CURRENT_LINK"
183	        refresh_compat_links
184	        svc_cmd restart "$SERVICE" || true
185	        if health_window 60 "$prev"; then
186	            fail "新版本 ${target} 健康失败，已回滚到 ${prev}（exit 2，新版本未转正）"
187	        fi
188	        fail "新版本 ${target} 健康失败且回滚后 ${prev} 也不健康（exit 3，需人工介入）"
189	    fi
190	    fail "新版本 ${target} 健康失败且无可回滚的上一版本（exit 3，需人工介入）"
191	}
192	
193	# 校验一个 release 目录：manifest 逐文件 sha256 + VERSION 合法。$1=dir
194	# 成功时 stdout 只输出版本号（诊断信息走 stderr）；失败直接 fail 退出
195	verify_release_dir() {
196	    local dir="$1"
197	    [ -f "$dir/VERSION" ] || fail "release 缺少 VERSION 文件：$dir"
198	    local ver; ver="$(tr -d '[:space:]' < "$dir/VERSION")"
199	    valid_version "$ver" || fail "VERSION 内容非法：$ver"
200	    if [ -f "$dir/manifest.sha256" ]; then
201	        # sha256sum -c 的 "file: FAILED" 行走 stdout，必须丢弃——否则会被
202	        # 命令替换方捕获进版本变量（实测踩过：ver 变成 "xxx: FAILED"）
203	        (cd "$dir" && sha256sum --quiet -c manifest.sha256 >/dev/null 2>&1) \
204	            || fail "manifest 完整性校验失败：$dir"
205	        info "manifest.sha256 全量校验通过（$(grep -c '^[0-9a-f]' "$dir/manifest.sha256" || true) 个文件）"
206	    else
207	        warn "release 无 manifest.sha256（开发机 adopt 场景可接受；正式包必须携带）"
208	    fi
209	    echo "$ver"
210	}
211	
212	# 签名验证（占位→真实）：公钥存在才强制；无公钥告警放行（Phase 2 接云侧发布密钥）
213	verify_signature() {  # $1=pkg 文件
214	    local pkg="$1" pub="${WEAKNET_RELEASE_PUB:-$ROOT/config/release_pub.pem}"
215	    if [ ! -f "$pub" ]; then
216	        warn "未配置发布公钥（$pub），跳过签名校验——Phase 2 接入云侧发布密钥后将强制"
217	        return 0
218	    fi
219	    [ -f "$pkg.sig" ] || fail "已配置发布公钥但缺少签名文件 $pkg.sig（fail-closed）"
220	    openssl pkeyutl -verify -pubin -inkey "$pub" -rawin \
221	        -in "$pkg" -sigfile "$pkg.sig" >/dev/null 2>&1 \
222	        || fail "包签名校验失败：$pkg"
223	    pass "Ed25519 签名校验通过"
224	}
225	
226	# 解包 + 校验 + 版本策略 → 输出 staging 目录路径。$1=pkg $2=allow_downgrade
227	stage_package() {
228	    local pkg="$1" allow="${2:-0}"
229	    [ -f "$pkg" ] || fail "升级包不存在：$pkg"
230	    verify_signature "$pkg"
231	    local cur; cur="$(current_version)"
232	    local staging="$RELEASES/.staging.$$"
233	    rm -rf "$staging"; mkdir -p "$staging"
234	    case "$pkg" in
235	        *.tar.zst|*.tzst) tar --zstd -xf "$pkg" -C "$staging" ;;
236	        *.tar.gz|*.tgz)   tar -zxf "$pkg" -C "$staging" ;;
237	        *.tar)            tar -xf "$pkg" -C "$staging" ;;
238	        *) rm -rf "$staging"; fail "不支持的包格式：$pkg（需 tar.zst/tar.gz/tar）" ;;
239	    esac
240	    local ver
241	    # 显式接住校验失败：函数内的 fail 在命令替换子 shell 里只体现为非零退出码，
242	    # 不加 || 会穿透 set -e 继续执行（实测踩过）
243	    ver="$(verify_release_dir "$staging")" || { rm -rf "$staging"; exit 1; }
244	    if ! version_allowed "$cur" "$ver" "$allow"; then
245	        rm -rf "$staging"
246	        fail "版本策略拒绝：current=${cur:-无} → target=${ver}（降级需 --allow-downgrade）"
247	    fi
248	    echo "$staging"
249	}
250	
251	install_self_script() {  # $1=新 release 目录：自更新脚本到稳定路径
252	    local rel="$1"
253	    if [ -f "$rel/weaknet-local-update.sh" ] && [ "$(readlink -f "$rel/weaknet-local-update.sh")" != "$(readlink -f "$0")" ]; then
254	        install -m 0755 "$rel/weaknet-local-update.sh" "$ROOT/weaknet-local-update.sh.new"
255	        mv -f "$ROOT/weaknet-local-update.sh.new" "$ROOT/weaknet-local-update.sh"
256	        info "升级脚本已自更新到 $ROOT/weaknet-local-update.sh"
257	    fi
258	}
259	
260	# ---- 子命令 -----------------------------------------------------------------
261	
262	cmd_status() {
263	    local cur; cur="$(current_version)"
264	    echo "root:            $ROOT"
265	    if [ -n "$cur" ]; then
266	        echo "layout:          releases"
267	        echo "installed:       $cur"
268	        echo "committed:       $([ -f "$RELEASES/$cur/.committed" ] && echo yes || echo no)"
269	    else
270	        echo "layout:          flat（未迁移，升级脚本首次 apply/adopt 后建立 releases 布局）"
271	        echo "installed:       unmanaged"
272	    fi
273	    local prev; prev="$(cat "$RELEASES/.previous" 2>/dev/null || true)"
274	    echo "previous:        ${prev:-无}"
275	    echo "releases:"
276	    local d
277	    for d in "$RELEASES"/*/; do
278	        [ -d "$d" ] || continue
279	        local v; v="$(basename "$d")"
280	        local mark=" "
281	        [ -e "$CURRENT_LINK" ] && [ "$(readlink "$CURRENT_LINK")" = "releases/$v" ] && mark="*"
282	        [ -f "$d/.committed" ] && mark="${mark}c" || mark="${mark} "
283	        echo "  $mark $v"
284	    done
285	}
286	
287	cmd_verify() {  # $1=pkg|dir
288	    local target="$1"
289	    [ -n "$target" ] || fail "用法：verify <pkg.tar.zst|release-dir>"
290	    if [ -d "$target" ]; then
291	        verify_release_dir "$target" >/dev/null
292	        pass "release 目录校验通过：$target"
293	    else
294	        local cur; cur="$(current_version)"
295	        local staging; staging="$(stage_package "$target" 0)" || exit 1
296	        local ver; ver="$(tr -d '[:space:]' < "$staging/VERSION")"
297	        rm -rf "$staging"
298	        pass "升级包校验通过：version=${ver}（current=${cur:-无}，策略允许）"
299	    fi
300	}
301	
302	cmd_apply() {  # $1=pkg 其余为选项
303	    require_root
304	    local pkg="$1"; shift
305	    local allow=0 health=1 htimeout=120
306	    while [ $# -gt 0 ]; do
307	        case "$1" in
308	            --allow-downgrade) allow=1 ;;
309	            --commit|--no-health) health=0 ;;
310	            --health-timeout) htimeout="$2"; shift ;;
311	            *) fail "apply 未知参数：$1" ;;
312	        esac
313	        shift
314	    done
315	    [ -n "$pkg" ] || fail "用法：apply <pkg.tar.zst> [--allow-downgrade] [--commit] [--health-timeout N]"
316	
317	    local cur; cur="$(current_version)"
318	    info "current=${cur:-无（首次/未迁移）} → 应用 $pkg"
319	    local staging; staging="$(stage_package "$pkg" "$allow")" || exit 1
320	    local ver; ver="$(tr -d '[:space:]' < "$staging/VERSION")"
321	
322	    svc_cmd stop "$SERVICE" 2>/dev/null || true
323	
324	    # 记录回滚指针（首次安装无 prev，写空）
325	    if [ -n "$cur" ]; then echo "$cur" > "$RELEASES/.previous"; else rm -f "$RELEASES/.previous"; fi
326	
327	    # 目标版本目录替换（同版本幂等重装）：旧副本保留到健康窗口通过才清理
328	    local old_dir=""
329	    if [ -d "$RELEASES/$ver" ]; then
330	        old_dir="$RELEASES/.$ver.old.$$"
331	        rm -rf "$old_dir"
332	        mv "$RELEASES/$ver" "$old_dir"
333	    fi
334	    mv "$staging" "$RELEASES/$ver"
335	    install_self_script "$RELEASES/$ver"
336	
337	    if [ "$health" = "0" ]; then
338	        atomic_symlink "releases/$ver" "$CURRENT_LINK"
339	        refresh_compat_links
340	        svc_cmd daemon-reload || true
341	        svc_cmd restart "$SERVICE" || warn "restart 返回非零（--commit 模式不看健康窗口）"
342	        touch "$RELEASES/$ver/.committed"
343	        [ -n "$old_dir" ] && rm -rf "$old_dir"
344	        warn "--commit：跳过健康窗口，已直接转正 releases/${ver}"
345	        return 0
346	    fi
347	
348	    flip_restart_commit "$ver" "$cur" "$htimeout" "$old_dir"
349	}
350	
351	cmd_rollback() {  # [--to <version>]
352	    require_root
353	    local target="" htimeout=120
354	    while [ $# -gt 0 ]; do
355	        case "$1" in
356	            --to) target="$2"; shift ;;
357	            --health-timeout) htimeout="$2"; shift ;;
358	            *) fail "rollback 未知参数：$1" ;;
359	        esac
360	        shift
361	    done
362	    local cur; cur="$(current_version)"
363	    [ -n "$cur" ] || fail "当前无 releases 布局，无法回滚"
364	    if [ -z "$target" ]; then
365	        target="$(cat "$RELEASES/.previous" 2>/dev/null || true)"
366	        [ -n "$target" ] || fail "无 .previous 记录，无法自动回滚；可用 --to <version> 指定"
367	    fi
368	    valid_version "$target" || fail "回滚目标版本非法：$target"
369	    [ -d "$RELEASES/$target" ] || fail "回滚目标不存在：releases/$target"
370	    [ "$target" = "$cur" ] && fail "回滚目标与当前版本相同：$cur"
371	
372	    info "回滚：${cur} → ${target}"
373	    echo "$cur" > "$RELEASES/.previous"   # 回滚后再回滚 = 回到刚放弃的版本
374	    svc_cmd stop "$SERVICE" 2>/dev/null || true
375	    flip_restart_commit "$target" "$cur" "$htimeout"
376	}
377	
378	cmd_adopt() {  # $1=staged-dir $2=version 其余为选项
379	    # ci.sh 集成：接管已 rsync 到板端的产物目录，完成布局迁移 + 切换 + 健康。
380	    require_root
381	    local staged="$1" ver="$2"; shift 2
382	    local health=1 htimeout=120
383	    while [ $# -gt 0 ]; do
384	        case "$1" in
385	            --commit|--no-health) health=0 ;;
386	            --health-timeout) htimeout="$2"; shift ;;
387	            *) fail "adopt 未知参数：$1" ;;
388	        esac
389	        shift
390	    done
391	    [ -d "$staged" ] || fail "staged 目录不存在：$staged"
392	    valid_version "$ver" || fail "版本号非法：$ver（需 X.Y.Z）"
393	    mkdir -p "$RELEASES"
394	
395	    # 首次迁移：旧扁平布局整体归档为 releases/legacy-flat（含 VERSION 占位）
396	    local cur; cur="$(current_version)"
397	    if [ -z "$cur" ] && [ -d "$ROOT/server" ] && [ ! -L "$ROOT/server" ]; then
398	        info "检测到旧扁平布局，归档为 releases/legacy-flat"
399	        mkdir -p "$RELEASES/legacy-flat"
400	        local e
401	        for e in server client lib edge_network_rag.py network_knowledge_base.py; do
402	            [ -e "$ROOT/$e" ] && [ ! -L "$ROOT/$e" ] && mv "$ROOT/$e" "$RELEASES/legacy-flat/" || true
403	        done
404	        echo "0.0.0" > "$RELEASES/legacy-flat/VERSION" 2>/dev/null || true
405	        touch "$RELEASES/legacy-flat/.committed"
406	    fi
407	
408	    # staged → releases/<ver>（补 VERSION/manifest/脚本，供后续 rollback 与校验）；
409	    # 同版本已存在时旧副本保留到健康窗口通过才清理
410	    local rel="$RELEASES/$ver" old_dir=""
411	    if [ -d "$rel" ]; then
412	        old_dir="$RELEASES/.$ver.old.$$"
413	        rm -rf "$old_dir"
414	        mv "$rel" "$old_dir"
415	    fi
416	    mv "$staged" "$rel"
417	    echo "$ver" > "$rel/VERSION"
418	    [ -f "$rel/weaknet-local-update.sh" ] || install -m 0755 "$0" "$rel/weaknet-local-update.sh"
419	    (cd "$rel" && find . -type f ! -name manifest.sha256 ! -name .committed -print0 \
420	        | sed -z 's|^\./||' | sort -z | xargs -0 sha256sum > manifest.sha256)
421	    verify_release_dir "$rel" >/dev/null
422	
423	    if [ -n "$cur" ]; then echo "$cur" > "$RELEASES/.previous"; else rm -f "$RELEASES/.previous"; fi
424	    install_self_script "$rel"
425	
426	    if [ "$health" = "0" ]; then
427	        atomic_symlink "releases/$ver" "$CURRENT_LINK"
428	        refresh_compat_links
429	        svc_cmd daemon-reload || true
430	        svc_cmd restart "$SERVICE" || warn "restart 返回非零"
431	        touch "$rel/.committed"
432	        [ -n "$old_dir" ] && rm -rf "$old_dir"
433	        warn "--no-health：跳过健康窗口直接转正 releases/${ver}"
434	        return 0
435	    fi
436	    flip_restart_commit "$ver" "$cur" "$htimeout" "$old_dir"
437	}
438	
439	cmd_package() {  # <dist-dir> <version> <out.tar.zst>
440	    local dist="$1" ver="$2" out="$3"
441	    [ -d "$dist" ] || fail "dist 目录不存在：$dist"
442	    valid_version "$ver" || fail "版本号非法：$ver（需 X.Y.Z）"
443	    echo "$ver" > "$dist/VERSION"
444	    if [ -f "$0" ]; then install -m 0755 "$0" "$dist/weaknet-local-update.sh"; fi
445	    (cd "$dist" && find . -type f ! -name manifest.sha256 -print0 \
446	        | sed -z 's|^\./||' | sort -z | xargs -0 sha256sum > manifest.sha256)
447	    mkdir -p "$(dirname "$out")"
448	    tar --zstd -cf "$out" -C "$dist" .
449	    if [ -n "${WEAKNET_RELEASE_PRIV:-}" ] && [ -f "${WEAKNET_RELEASE_PRIV}" ]; then
450	        openssl pkeyutl -sign -rawin -inkey "$WEAKNET_RELEASE_PRIV" \
451	            -in "$out" -sigfile "$out.sig"
452	        pass "已签名：$out.sig"
453	    else
454	        warn "未设 WEAKNET_RELEASE_PRIV，包未签名（Phase 1 本地信任可接受）"
455	    fi
456	    pass "打包完成：$out ($(du -h "$out" | cut -f1))"
457	}
458	
459	# ---- 入口 -------------------------------------------------------------------
460	
461	usage() { sed -n '2,30p' "$0" | sed 's/^# \{0,1\}//'; }
462	
463	main() {
464	    local cmd="${1:-}"
465	    [ -n "$cmd" ] || { usage; exit 1; }
466	    shift || true
467	    case "$cmd" in
468	        status)   cmd_status "$@" ;;
469	        verify)   cmd_verify "$@" ;;
470	        apply)    cmd_apply "$@" ;;
471	        rollback) cmd_rollback "$@" ;;
472	        adopt)    cmd_adopt "$@" ;;
473	        package)  cmd_package "$@" ;;
474	        -h|--help|help) usage ;;
475	        *) usage; fail "未知命令：$cmd" ;;
476	    esac
477	}
478	
479	main "$@"
480	
</system-reminder>

# ---- 产物不携带构建机专用路径 ----

# ---- 服务端源文件（显式清单；CMake GLOB → 显式化，见下） ----
# 曾是 file(GLOB ... CONFIGURE_DEPENDS)：GLOB 在团队协作/分支切换/临时调试时
# 静默吞掉新增或删除的 .cpp（未触发重新配置 → 符号未定义或废弃代码误链接），
# 与仓库其它显式 target 风格不一致。新增源文件必须在此登记（main.cpp /
# server.cpp 单独进 weaknet-dbus-server target；history_query_tool 独立 target）。
set(SERVER_SOURCES
    src/active_connectivity_monitor.cpp
    src/assurance/action_registry.cpp
    src/assurance/dns_transaction_tracker.cpp
    src/assurance/edge_ai_scheduler.cpp
    src/band_conflict_detector.cpp
    src/bt_audio_analyzer.cpp
    src/bt_audio_fusion.cpp
    src/bt_data_path_analyzer.cpp
    src/bt_data_path_anomaly_detector.cpp
    src/bt_event_monitor.cpp
    src/bt_event_normalizer.cpp
    src/bt_hci_connection_tracker.cpp
    src/bt_link_quality_tracker.cpp
    src/bt_monitor.cpp
    src/database_manager.cpp
    src/dbus_service.cpp
    src/dns_monitor.cpp
    src/ebpf_monitor_metrics.cpp
    src/edge_telemetry_exporter.cpp
    src/edge_wireless_uplink_exporter.cpp
    src/event_manager.cpp
    src/http_latency_monitor.cpp
    src/iface_type.cpp
    src/logger.cpp
    src/looper.cpp
    src/monitor_ebpf_plugins.cpp
    src/monitor_manager.cpp
    src/monitor_plugins.cpp
    src/monitor_registry.cpp
    src/net_iface.cpp
    src/net_info.cpp
    src/net_ping.cpp
    src/net_tcp.cpp
    src/net_traffic.cpp
    src/net_wifiriss.cpp
    src/network_epoch_store.cpp
    src/process_net_profiler.cpp
    src/rssi_monitor.cpp
    src/rtt_monitor.cpp
    src/serializer.cpp
    src/site_incident_correlator.cpp
    src/site_incident.cpp
    src/skb_drop_monitor.cpp
    src/tcp_connect_monitor.cpp
    src/tcp_conn_monitor.cpp
    src/tcp_loss_monitor.cpp
    src/tcp_retransmit_monitor.cpp
    src/tcp_rtt_monitor.cpp
    src/tls_probe_client.cpp
    src/topology_collector.cpp
    src/traffic_analyzer.cpp
    src/update_status.cpp
    src/using_iface.cpp
    src/utils/bpf_map_sizing.cpp
    src/utils/json_escape.cpp
    src/weaknet_config.cpp
    src/weak_netmgr.cpp
    src/wifi_packet_loss_monitor.cpp
    src/wireless_event.cpp
    src/wireless_event_store.cpp
)

# ---- 公共代码库（客户端和服务端共享 serializer + logger + json_escape） ----
add_library(weaknet_common STATIC src/serializer.cpp src/logger.cpp src/utils/json_escape.cpp)
target_include_directories(weaknet_common PUBLIC
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include)
set_target_properties(weaknet_common PROPERTIES POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)

# ---- 服务端静态库（供测试链接） ----
add_library(server_lib STATIC ${SERVER_SOURCES})
target_include_directories(server_lib PUBLIC
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include)

find_package(PkgConfig REQUIRED)
# QEMU ARM64 模拟下 cmake try_compile 会 segfault，手动设置 pthread
set(CMAKE_THREAD_PREFER_PTHREAD TRUE)
set(THREADS_PREFER_PTHREAD_FLAG TRUE)
pkg_check_modules(DBUS1 REQUIRED IMPORTED_TARGET dbus-1)
pkg_check_modules(NL80211 QUIET IMPORTED_TARGET libnl-3.0 libnl-genl-3.0)
find_library(SQLITE3_LIB sqlite3 REQUIRED)
target_link_libraries(server_lib PUBLIC
    PkgConfig::DBUS1 glog bpf pthread ${SQLITE3_LIB}
    $<$<BOOL:${NL80211_FOUND}>:PkgConfig::NL80211>)

# ---- W1: OpenSSL（TLS 探测能力）----
#
# 双路径探测，按优先级：
#   1. 私有 sysroot ${WEAKNET_OPENSSL_SYSROOT}（ARM64 构建容器的主路径）
#      libssl-dev 不经 APT 安装（bullseye-security 索引/pool 不一致导致
#      恒 404；bullseye/main 的 deb11u1 又与镜像已装 libssl1.1 deb11u8
#      版本冲突），改由 scripts/setup_openssl_sysroot.sh 以固定 .deb +
#      SHA256 校验 + dpkg-deb -x 解压得到。
#   2. 系统 OpenSSL（x86 开发机，实测为 3.5.5）
#
# 两个 backend 的 API 差异（1.1 vs 3.x）由源码内
# #if OPENSSL_VERSION_NUMBER 适配，CMake 只负责定位与链接。
#
# 链接范围 PRIVATE：公共头不暴露任何 OpenSSL 类型，不把 TLS 依赖
# 传播给 server_lib 的消费者。
#
# 找不到时不 fail：TLS 能力按项目语义降级为 NO_CAPABILITY
# （对应 SleResult.scope = NO_CAPABILITY、reason = no_tls_probe_capability），
# 而不是让整个构建失败。
set(WEAKNET_OPENSSL_SYSROOT "/opt/weaknet-openssl-1.1"
    CACHE PATH "OpenSSL 1.1 私有 sysroot（ARM64 构建容器）")

# 1) 私有 sysroot：NO_DEFAULT_PATH 确保不会误拾系统库
# 默认 FALSE：仅 sysroot 后端会置 TRUE（决定是否剥掉构建期 RUNPATH）
set(WEAKNET_TLS_IS_SYSROOT FALSE)
find_path(WEAKNET_OPENSSL_SYSROOT_INCLUDE_DIR openssl/ssl.h
    PATHS "${WEAKNET_OPENSSL_SYSROOT}/usr/include"
    NO_DEFAULT_PATH)
find_library(WEAKNET_OPENSSL_SYSROOT_SSL_LIB NAMES ssl
    PATHS "${WEAKNET_OPENSSL_SYSROOT}/usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu"
    NO_DEFAULT_PATH)
find_library(WEAKNET_OPENSSL_SYSROOT_CRYPTO_LIB NAMES crypto
    PATHS "${WEAKNET_OPENSSL_SYSROOT}/usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu"
    NO_DEFAULT_PATH)

if(WEAKNET_OPENSSL_SYSROOT_INCLUDE_DIR
   AND WEAKNET_OPENSSL_SYSROOT_SSL_LIB
   AND WEAKNET_OPENSSL_SYSROOT_CRYPTO_LIB)
    set(WEAKNET_TLS_FOUND TRUE)
    set(WEAKNET_TLS_IS_SYSROOT TRUE)
    set(WEAKNET_TLS_BACKEND "sysroot:${WEAKNET_OPENSSL_SYSROOT}")
    # Debian multiarch 布局：opensslconf.h 在 aarch64-linux-gnu/ 子目录下，
    # 只加 usr/include 会报 "openssl/opensslconf.h: No such file".

    CACHE PATH "libcurl 私有 sysroot（ARM64 构建容器）")

# OTA Phase 1 本地升级 — 实施计划

## Context

为什么做：当前板端升级靠 `tools/ci.sh` 从开发机 rsync 覆盖（`--delete`），无版本概念、无原子性、无回滚。两块板以上即不可运维。OTA Phase 1 只做**板端本地闭环**（解包校验 → 原子切换 → 健康窗口 → 自动回滚），零云端依赖，是后续云侧制品链（Phase 2）与审批执行链（Phase 3）的前置地基，也是运维刚需。

用户已选：OTA Phase 1 本地升级（DPDK 学习实验与 ideas-only 备选已搁置）。本计划只覆盖 Phase 1；Phase 2/3 另立 change。

前置事实（只读调研已确认）：
- 板端布局：`/home/radxa/weaknet/`（server/bin、server/build/*.bpf.o、data/、config/），服务单元 `tools/weaknet-server.service`（`ExecStart=…/server/bin/weaknet-dbus-server --config /etc/weaknet/config.yaml`，`WorkingDirectory=…/server`，root + 5 capabilities）。
- `dist-arm64/` 结构：server/bin、server/build、server/test、client/bin、client/lib、lib（28MB，zstd 后约 10MB）。
- 升级必须原位保留的 5 个状态文件：`data/history.db`、`data/network-epoch`、`data/wireless-uplink-state`、`data/runtime-overrides.bin`、`data/config_txn_state`（路径解析 `server/include/common.hpp`）。
- 可复用模式：`ConfigTransaction` 180s 试用看门狗（`server/include/weaknet_config.hpp:343`、`server/src/weaknet_config.cpp:1073`，tmp+rename 持久化 + 开机崩溃回滚）；板端下行 `EVP_DigestVerify` 验签模式（`server/src/edge_telemetry_exporter.cpp:679`）；健康判据 `HealthCheck`/`GetEbpfMonitorHealth`（`server/src/dbus_service.cpp:394,1348`）。
- 无版本来源：`config.yaml`、CMake（`project(weaknet VERSION 1.0.0)` 静态）、`WeakNetConfig` 均无固件版本键。`ai_snapshot.json` 为 idle，无 active change，可新建 change。

## 推荐方案（只写这一个，不展开备选）

**独立 shell 脚本 + CLI 薄封装 + 服务端只读状态方法**，releases 目录 + `current` 软链接原子翻转：

```
板端 /home/radxa/weaknet/
├── releases/<version>/   # server/ client/ lib/ + manifest.json（sha256 清单 + 版本）
├── current -> releases/<version>   # 原子翻转点（rename）
├── data/                 # 5 个状态文件，升级永不触碰
└── config/               # edge_priv.pem，升级永不触碰
```

1. **版本单一来源**：仓库根新增 `VERSION` 文件（一行 semver）。CMake 读入编译进二进制（`--version` 输出）；`ci.sh --release`（或本地打包命令）用它给 manifest 盖戳；服务端新增只读 D-Bus 方法 `GetUpdateStatus` 上报当前版本 + slot 状态。单调递增检查拒绝降级（防回滚攻击的本地版）。
2. **包格式**：`weaknet-<version>.tar.zst` + `manifest.json`（文件→sha256、版本、最低兼容标记）。Phase 1 做 sha256 全量校验 + 版本单调检查；Ed25519 分离式签名**验签位先占后实现**（验签函数按 `edge_telemetry_exporter.cpp:679` 的 `EVP_DigestVerify` 模式写，若发布公钥不存在则告警通过——避免 Phase 2 返工，不阻塞 Phase 1 闭环）。
3. **执行体**：新增 `tools/weaknet-local-update.sh`（`apply/status/rollback/verify` 四子命令，随包部署到板）。`weaknet-cli` 新增 `update` 子命令，**apply/rollback 直接 fork+exec 该脚本**（不停留 D-Bus——服务端不能在调用中途杀死自己），`update status` 走 D-Bus `GetUpdateStatus` 只读查询。root 限权沿用现有 `requireRootCaller` 惯例。
4. **原子切换**：解包到 `releases/<version>/` → 校验 → `ln -sfn` 到临时名 → `rename` 翻转 `current` → `systemctl restart weaknet-server`。服务单元改为经 `current` 寻址（`ExecStart` + `WorkingDirectory` 同步改，`bpf_obj` 相对路径解析随工作目录走——实现时以 `server.cpp` 实际解析逻辑为准，必要时改为绝对路径）。
5. **健康窗口 + 自动回滚**：重启后脚本轮询（默认 180s，复用看门狗窗口语义）：D-Bus `HealthCheck` 有响应 + `GetEbpfMonitorHealth` 探针 attach 数正常 + 进程存活。全绿则 commit（写 `releases/<version>/.committed` 标记）；任一失败则翻回上一版 symlink 并重启。`data/` 与 `/etc/weaknet/config.yaml` 全程只读。
6. **目录漂移清单**：任何改动 `ActionRegistry`/trial 白名单的版本，发布 checklist 必须含"云端同步审阅目录"（`docs/网关动作目录版本契约.md` fail-closed 防线，否则升级后远程动作全被自拦）。

## 关键文件

- 新增：`VERSION`（根）、`tools/weaknet-local-update.sh`、`server/src/update_status.cpp`（+ `server/include/update_status.hpp`，读 `current` symlink 与 manifest）。
- 修改：`client/weaknet_cli.cpp`（`update` 子命令分发，仿现有 `action` 命令风格）、`server/src/dbus_service.cpp`（新增 `GetUpdateStatus` 只读方法）、`tools/weaknet-server.service`（经 `current` 寻址）、`tools/ci.sh`（打包 manifest + 部署脚本；**不改部署语义**，只增产物）、`CMakeLists.txt`/`server/CMakeLists.txt`（读 `VERSION`、编译新源）、`docs/weaknet_cli_usage.md`（同步文档，项目铁律：文档与代码同步）。
- 不碰：`data/` 下 5 文件、`/etc/weaknet/config.yaml`、`config/` 密钥、`scripts/`（harness 禁改）。

## 执行路径（工作流外，按用户指示不走 OpenSpec change）

按 CLAUDE.md「工作流外任务必须留记录」铁律执行（不走 change 仍必须留记录）：

1. 改代码前先按 `test-driven-development` 写 RED 测试（gtest：manifest 校验、版本单调比较、symlink 翻转纯函数逻辑），再实现转绿；shell 部分 `sh -n` + 沙盒演练。
2. 本地验证全绿（`test-all` 48 套件不回归）后，**经你批准**再跑 `./tools/ci.sh` 部署到板做真机演练（项目规则：禁止跳过本地验证直接 push；Git 提交也只在你明确要求时执行）。
3. 完成后建 `openspec/tasks/2026-10-19-ota-local-update.md`，按 `openspec/tasks/README.md` 三节模板记录构思/实现方式/结果（该目录不受 harness 约束，但无验收效力——真机演练结论写进"结果"节）。
4. 同步文档铁律：`docs/weaknet_cli_usage.md` 补 `update` 子命令用法。

## 验证

- x86：`test-all` 全绿（新增 gtest 覆盖：manifest 校验、版本单调比较、symlink 翻转逻辑纯函数；shell 脚本逻辑配 `sh -n` + 本地沙盒演练）。
- 板端（blocking 证据）：① 同版本 apply 幂等成功；② 篡改包 sha256 被拒；③ 正常升级 commit；④ 注入坏二进制（启动即崩）触发自动回滚到上一版且 `data/` 5 文件完好、`history.db` 可读。经 `weaknet-test-full.sh` 风格冒烟 + `task_verify.sh --project-command` 留痕。
- 回归：`HealthCheck`/`GetEbpfMonitorHealth`/上行游标（`wireless-uplink-state`）升级前后连续，`catalog_version` 无漂移误报。

tools.name: AskUserQuestion
tools.description:
Use this tool only when you are blocked on a decision that is genuinely the user's to make: one you cannot resolve from the request, the code, or sensible defaults.

Usage notes:
- Users will always be able to select "Other" to provide custom text input
- Use multiSelect: true to allow multiple answers to be selected for a question
- If you recommend a specific option, make that the first option in the list and add "(Recommended)" at the end of the label

Plan mode note: To switch into plan mode, use EnterPlanMode (not this tool). Once in plan mode, use this tool to clarify requirements or choose between approaches BEFORE finalizing your plan. Do NOT use this tool to ask "Is my plan ready?", "Should I proceed?", or otherwise reference "the plan" in questions — the user cannot see the plan until you call ExitPlanMode for approval.

Reserve this for decisions where the user's answer changes what you do next — not for choices with a conventional default or facts you can verify in the codebase yourself. In those cases pick the obvious option, mention it in your response, and proceed.

Preview feature:
Use the optional `preview` field on options when presenting concrete artifacts that users need to visually compare:
- ASCII mockups of UI layouts or components
- Code snippets showing different implementations
- Diagram variations
- Configuration examples

Preview content is rendered as markdown in a monospace box. Multi-line text with newlines is supported. When any option has a preview, the UI switches to a side-by-side layout with a vertical option list on the left and preview on the right. Do not use previews for simple preference questions where labels and descriptions suffice. Note: previews are only supported for single-select questions (not multiSelect).

tools.name: CronCreate
tools.description:
Schedule a prompt to be enqueued at a future time. Use for both recurring schedules and one-shot reminders.

Uses standard 5-field cron in the user's local timezone: minute hour day-of-month month day-of-week. "0 9 * * *" means 9am local — no timezone conversion needed.

## One-shot tasks (recurring: false)

For "remind me at X" or "at <time>, do Y" requests — fire once then auto-delete.
Pin minute/hour/day-of-month/month to specific values:
  "remind me at 2:30pm today to check the deploy" → cron: "30 14 <today_dom> <today_month> *", recurring: false
  "tomorrow morning, run the smoke test" → cron: "57 8 <tomorrow_dom> <tomorrow_month> *", recurring: false

## Recurring jobs (recurring: true, the default)

For "every N minutes" / "every hour" / "weekdays at 9am" requests:
  "*/5 * * * *" (every 5 min), "0 * * * *" (hourly), "0 9 * * 1-5" (weekdays at 9am local)

## Avoid the :00 and :30 minute marks when the task allows it

Every user who asks for "9am" gets `0 9`, and every user who asks for "hourly" gets `0 *` — which means requests from across the planet land on the API at the same instant. When the user's request is approximate, pick a minute that is NOT 0 or 30:
  "every morning around 9" → "57 8 * * *" or "3 9 * * *" (not "0 9 * * *")
  "hourly" → "7 * * * *" (not "0 * * * *")
  "in an hour or so, remind me to..." → pick whatever minute you land on, don't round

Only use minute 0 or 30 when the user names that exact time and clearly means it ("at 9:00 sharp", "at half past", coordinating with a meeting). When in doubt, nudge a few minutes early or late — the user will not notice, and the fleet will.

## Durability

By default (durable: false) the job lives only in this Claude session — nothing is written to disk, and the job is gone when Claude exits. Pass durable: true to write to .claude/scheduled_tasks.json so the job survives restarts. Only use durable: true when the user explicitly asks for the task to persist ("keep doing this every day", "set this up permanently"). Most "remind me in 5 minutes" / "check back in an hour" requests should stay session-only.

## Runtime behavior

Jobs only fire while the REPL is idle (not mid-query). Durable jobs persist to .claude/scheduled_tasks.json and survive session restarts — on next launch they resume automatically. One-shot durable tasks that were missed while the REPL was closed are surfaced for catch-up. Session-only jobs die with the process. The scheduler adds a small deterministic jitter on top of whatever you pick: recurring tasks fire up to 10% of their period late (max 15 min); one-shot tasks landing on :00 or :30 fire up to 90 s early. Picking an off-minute is still the bigger lever.

Recurring tasks auto-expire after 7 days — they fire one final time, then are deleted. This bounds session lifetime. Tell the user about the 7-day limit when scheduling recurring jobs.

Returns a job ID you can pass to CronDelete.

tools.name: EnterPlanMode
tools.description:
Use this tool proactively when you're about to start a non-trivial implementation task. Getting user sign-off on your approach before writing code prevents wasted effort and ensures alignment. This tool transitions you into plan mode where you can explore the codebase and design an implementation approach for user approval.

## When to Use This Tool

**Prefer using EnterPlanMode** for implementation tasks unless they're simple. Use it when ANY of these conditions apply:

1. **New Feature Implementation**: Adding meaningful new functionality
   - Example: "Add a logout button" - where should it go? What should happen on click?
   - Example: "Add form validation" - what rules? What error messages?

2. **Multiple Valid Approaches**: The task can be solved in several different ways
   - Example: "Add caching to the API" - could use Redis, in-memory, file-based, etc.
   - Example: "Improve performance" - many optimization strategies possible

3. **Code Modifications**: Changes that affect existing behavior or structure
   - Example: "Update the login flow" - what exactly should change?
   - Example: "Refactor this component" - what's the target architecture?

4. **Architectural Decisions**: The task requires choosing between patterns or technologies
   - Example: "Add real-time updates" - WebSockets vs SSE vs polling
   - Example: "Implement state management" - Redux vs Context vs custom solution

5. **Multi-File Changes**: The task will likely touch more than 2-3 files
   - Example: "Refactor the authentication system"
   - Example: "Add a new API endpoint with tests"

6. **Unclear Requirements**: You need to explore before understanding the full scope
   - Example: "Make the app faster" - need to profile and identify bottlenecks
   - Example: "Fix the bug in checkout" - need to investigate root cause

7. **User Preferences Matter**: The implementation could reasonably go multiple ways
   - If you would use AskUserQuestion to clarify the approach, use EnterPlanMode instead
   - Plan mode lets you explore first, then present options with context

## When NOT to Use This Tool

Only skip EnterPlanMode for simple tasks:
- Single-line or few-line fixes (typos, obvious bugs, small tweaks)
- Adding a single function with clear requirements
- Tasks where the user has given very specific, detailed instructions
- Pure research/exploration tasks (use the Agent tool instead)

## What Happens in Plan Mode

In plan mode, you'll:
1. Thoroughly explore the codebase using `find`/Glob, `grep`/Grep, and Read
2. Understand existing patterns and architecture
3. Design an implementation approach
4. Present your plan to the user for approval
5. Use AskUserQuestion if you need to clarify approaches
6. Exit plan mode with ExitPlanMode when ready to implement

## Examples

### GOOD - Use EnterPlanMode:
User: "Add user authentication to the app"
- Requires architectural decisions (session vs JWT, where to store tokens, middleware structure)

User: "Optimize the database queries"
- Multiple approaches possible, need to profile first, significant impact

User: "Implement dark mode"
- Architectural decision on theme system, affects many components

User: "Add a delete button to the user profile"
- Seems simple but involves: where to place it, confirmation dialog, API call, error handling, state updates

User: "Update the error handling in the API"
- Affects multiple files, user should approve the approach

### BAD - Don't use EnterPlanMode:
User: "Fix the typo in the README"
- Straightforward, no planning needed

User: "Add a console.log to debug this function"
- Simple, obvious implementation

User: "What files handle routing?"
- Research task, not implementation planning

## Important Notes

- This tool REQUIRES user approval - they must consent to entering plan mode
- If unsure whether to use it, err on the side of planning - it's better to get alignment upfront than to redo work
- Users appreciate being consulted before significant changes are made to their codebase

2. Understand existing patterns and architecture
3. Design an implementation approach
4. Present your plan to the user for approval
5. Use AskUserQuestion if you need to clarify approaches
6. Exit plan mode with ExitPlanMode when ready to implement

## Examples

### GOOD - Use EnterPlanMode:
User: "Add user authentication to the app"
- Requires architectural decisions (session vs JWT, where to store tokens, middleware structure)

User: "Optimize the database queries"
- Multiple approaches possible, need to profile first, significant impact

User: "Implement dark mode"
- Architectural decision on theme system, affects many components

User: "Add a delete button to the user profile"
- Seems simple but involves: where to place it, confirmation dialog, API call, error handling, state updates

User: "Update the error handling in the API"
- Affects multiple files, user should approve the approach

### BAD - Don't use EnterPlanMode:
User: "Fix the typo in the README"
- Straightforward, no planning needed

User: "Add a console.log to debug this function"
- Simple, obvious implementation

User: "What files handle routing?"
- Research task, not implementation planning

## Important Notes

- This tool REQUIRES user approval - they must consent to entering plan mode
- If unsure whether to use it, err on the side of planning - it's better to get alignment upfront than to redo work
- Users appreciate being consulted before significant changes are made to their codebase

tools.name: EnterWorktree
tools.description:
Use this tool ONLY when explicitly instructed to work in a worktree — either by the user directly, or by project instructions (CLAUDE.md / memory). This tool creates an isolated git worktree and switches the current session into it.

## When to Use

- The user explicitly says "worktree" (e.g., "start a worktree", "work in a worktree", "create a worktree", "use a worktree")
- CLAUDE.md or memory instructions direct you to work in a worktree for the current task

## When NOT to Use

- The user asks to create a branch, switch branches, or work on a different branch — use git commands instead
- The user asks to fix a bug or work on a feature — use normal git workflow unless worktrees are explicitly requested by the user or project instructions
- Never use this tool unless "worktree" is explicitly mentioned by the user or in CLAUDE.md / memory instructions

## Requirements

- Must be in a git repository, OR have WorktreeCreate/WorktreeRemove hooks configured in settings.json
- Must not already be in a worktree session when creating a new worktree (`name`); switching into another existing worktree via `path` is allowed

## Behavior

- In a git repository: creates a new git worktree inside `.claude/worktrees/` on a new branch. The base ref is governed by the `worktree.baseRef` setting: `fresh` (default) branches from origin/<default-branch>; `head` branches from your current local HEAD
- Outside a git repository: delegates to WorktreeCreate/WorktreeRemove hooks for VCS-agnostic isolation
- Switches the session's working directory to the new worktree
- Use ExitWorktree to leave the worktree mid-session (keep or remove). On session exit, if still in the worktree, the user will be prompted to keep or remove it

## Entering an existing worktree

Pass `path` instead of `name` to switch the session into a worktree that already exists (e.g., one you just created with `git worktree add`). On first entry from the launch directory, the path must appear in `git worktree list` for the repository that owns it — the current repository or, in a multi-repo workspace, a repository nested inside it; paths registered by neither are rejected. ExitWorktree will not remove a worktree entered this way; use `action: "keep"` to return to the original directory.

Switching with `path` also works when the session is already in a worktree (the previous worktree is left on disk, untouched, and only the new one is tracked for exit-time cleanup), and from agents whose working directory was pinned at launch (subagent isolation or explicit cwd). In both cases the target must be a worktree under `.claude/worktrees/` of the same repository, and from a pinned agent the switch only affects this agent, not the parent session. After a further switch, previously-visited worktrees are no longer writable — re-issue EnterWorktree with `path` to return to one.

## Parameters

- `name` (optional): A name for a new worktree. If neither `name` nor `path` is provided, a random name is generated.
- `path` (optional): Path to an existing worktree to enter instead of creating one — of the current repository, or (on first entry from the launch directory) of a repository nested inside it. Mutually exclusive with `name`.

tools.name: ExitPlanMode
tools.description:
Use this tool when you are in plan mode and have finished writing your plan to the plan file and are ready for user approval.

## How This Tool Works
- You should have already written your plan to the plan file specified in the plan mode system message
- This tool does NOT take the plan content as a parameter - it will read the plan from the file you wrote
- This tool simply signals that you're done planning and ready for the user to review and approve
- The user will see the contents of your plan file when they review it

## When to Use This Tool
IMPORTANT: Only use this tool when the task requires planning the implementation steps of a task that requires writing code. For research tasks where you're gathering information, searching files, reading files or in general trying to understand the codebase - do NOT use this tool.

## Before Using This Tool
Ensure your plan is complete and unambiguous:
- If you have unresolved questions about requirements or approach, use AskUserQuestion first (in earlier phases)
- Once your plan is finalized, use THIS tool to request approval

**Important:** Do NOT use AskUserQuestion to ask "Is this plan okay?" or "Should I proceed?" - that's exactly what THIS tool does. ExitPlanMode inherently requests user approval of your plan.

## Examples

1. Initial task: "Search for and understand the implementation of vim mode in the codebase" - Do not use the exit plan mode tool because you are not planning the implementation steps of a task.
2. Initial task: "Help me implement yank mode for vim" - Use the exit plan mode tool after you have finished planning the implementation steps of the task.
3. Initial task: "Add a new feature to handle user authentication" - If unsure about auth method (OAuth, JWT, etc.), use AskUserQuestion first, then use exit plan mode tool after clarifying the approach.

tools.name: ExitWorktree
tools.description:
Exit a worktree session created by EnterWorktree and return the session to the original working directory.

## Scope

This tool ONLY operates on worktrees created by EnterWorktree in this session. It will NOT touch:
- Worktrees you created manually with `git worktree add`
- Worktrees from a previous session (even if created by EnterWorktree then)
- The directory you're in if EnterWorktree was never called

If called outside an EnterWorktree session, the tool is a **no-op**: it reports that no worktree session is active and takes no action. Filesystem state is unchanged.

## When to Use

- The user explicitly asks to "exit the worktree", "leave the worktree", "go back", or otherwise end the worktree session
- Do NOT call this proactively — only when the user asks

## Parameters

- `action` (required): `"keep"` or `"remove"`
  - `"keep"` — leave the worktree directory and branch intact on disk. Use this if the user wants to come back to the work later, or if there are changes to preserve.
  - `"remove"` — delete the worktree directory and its branch. Use this for a clean exit when the work is done or abandoned.
- `discard_changes` (optional, default false): only meaningful with `action: "remove"`. If the worktree has uncommitted files or commits not on the original branch, the tool will REFUSE to remove it unless this is set to `true`. If the tool returns an error listing changes, confirm with the user before re-invoking with `discard_changes: true`.

## Behavior

- Restores the session's working directory to where it was before EnterWorktree
- Clears CWD-dependent caches (system prompt sections, memory files, plans directory) so the session state reflects the original directory
- If a tmux session was attached to the worktree: killed on `remove`, left running on `keep` (its name is returned so the user can reattach)
- Once exited, EnterWorktree can be called again to create a fresh worktree

tools.name: NotebookEdit
tools.description:
Replaces, inserts, or deletes a single cell in a Jupyter notebook (.ipynb file).

Usage:
- You must use the Read tool on the notebook in this conversation before editing — this tool will fail otherwise.
- `notebook_path` must be an absolute path.
- `cell_id` is the `id` attribute shown in the Read tool's `<cell id="...">` output. It is required for `replace` and `delete`.
- `edit_mode` defaults to `replace`. Use `insert` to add a new cell after the cell with the given `cell_id` (or at the beginning of the notebook if `cell_id` is omitted) — `cell_type` is required when inserting. Use `delete` to remove the cell.

tools.name: Read
tools.description:
Reads a file from the local filesystem.

- `file_path` must be an absolute path.
- Reads up to 2000 lines by default.
- When you already know which part of the file you need, only read that part. This can be important for larger files.
- Results are returned using cat -n format, with line numbers starting at 1
- Reads images (PNG, JPG, …) and presents them visually. Reads PDFs via the `pages` parameter (e.g. "1-5", max 20 pages/request; required for PDFs over 10 pages). Reads Jupyter notebooks (.ipynb) as cells with outputs.
- Reading a directory, a missing file, or an empty file returns an error or system reminder rather than content.
- Do NOT re-read a file you just edited to verify — Edit/Write would have errored if the change failed, and the harness tracks file state for you.

tools.name: ScheduleWakeup
tools.description:
Schedule when to resume work in /loop dynamic mode — the user invoked /loop without an interval, asking you to self-pace iterations of a specific task.

Do NOT schedule a short-interval wakeup to poll for background work you started — when harness-tracked work finishes, you are re-invoked automatically, so polling is wasted. Instead schedule a long fallback (1200s+) so the loop survives if the work hangs or never notifies. The exception is external work the harness cannot track (a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue) — there, pick a delay matched to how fast that state actually changes.

Pass the same /loop prompt back via `prompt` each turn so the next firing repeats the task. For an autonomous /loop (no user prompt), pass the literal sentinel `<<autonomous-loop-dynamic>>` as `prompt` instead — the runtime resolves it back to the autonomous-loop instructions at fire time. (There is a similar `<<autonomous-loop>>` sentinel for CronCreate-based autonomous loops; do not confuse the two — ScheduleWakeup always uses the `-dynamic` variant.) To end the loop, call this tool with `stop: true` (omit every other field) — the loop ends immediately and no further wakeups fire.

Set `noop: true` if nothing changed — you checked and there's nothing to report ("no change", "still waiting", "quiet hold"). Set `noop: false` if something happened worth keeping — you edited a file, posted a message, advanced state, or surfaced a finding. Consecutive `noop: true` ticks are collapsed in the user's terminal view and tracked as a streak, so long quiet holds stay legible to the user without scrolling. Omit `noop` when stopping (`stop: true`).

## Picking delaySeconds

This session's requests use the default 5-minute Anthropic prompt-cache TTL. Sleeping past 300 seconds means the next wake-up reads your full conversation context uncached — slower and more expensive. So the natural breakpoints:

- **Under 5 minutes (60s–270s)**: cache stays warm. Right for actively polling external state the harness can't notify you about — a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue.
- **5 minutes to 1 hour (300s–3600s)**: pay the cache miss. Right when there's no point checking sooner — waiting on something that takes minutes to change, genuinely idle, or as the long fallback heartbeat when something else is the primary wake signal.

**Don't pick 300s.** It's the worst-of-both: you pay the cache miss without amortizing it. If you're tempted to "wait 5 minutes," either drop to 270s (stay in cache) or commit to 1200s+ (one cache miss buys a much longer wait). Don't think in round-number minutes — think in cache windows.

For idle ticks with no specific signal to watch, default to **1200s–1800s** (20–30 min). The loop checks back, you don't burn cache 12× per hour for nothing, and the user can always interrupt if they need you sooner.

Think about what you're actually waiting for, not just "how long should I sleep." If you're polling a CI run that takes ~8 minutes, sleeping 60s burns the cache 8 times before it finishes — sleep ~270s twice instead.

The runtime clamps to [60, 3600], so you don't need to clamp yourself.

## The reason field

One short sentence on what you chose and why. Goes to telemetry and is shown back to the user. "watching CI run" beats "waiting." The user reads this to understand what you're doing without having to predict your cadence in advance — make it specific.

tools.name: SendMessage
tools.description:
# SendMessage

Send a message to another agent.

```json
{"to": "researcher", "summary": "assign task 1", "message": "start on task #1"}
```

| `to` | |
|---|---|
| `"researcher"` | Teammate by name |
| `"main"` | The main conversation (background subagents only) |

tools.name: Workflow
tools.description:
Execute a workflow script that orchestrates multiple subagents deterministically. Workflows run in the background — this tool returns immediately with a task ID, and a <task-notification> arrives when the workflow completes. Use /workflows to watch live progress.

ONLY call this tool when the user has explicitly opted into multi-agent orchestration. Workflows can spawn dozens of agents and consume a large amount of tokens; the user must request that scale, not have it inferred. Explicit opt-in means one of:
- The user included the keyword "ultracode" in their prompt (you'll see a system-reminder confirming it).
- Ultracode is on for the session (a system-reminder confirms it) — see **Ultracode** in the workflow authoring reference.
- The user directly asked you to run a workflow or use multi-agent orchestration in their own words ("use a workflow", "run a workflow", "fan out agents", "orchestrate this with subagents"). The ask must be in the user's words — a task that would merely benefit from a workflow does not count.
- The user invoked a skill or slash command whose instructions tell you to call Workflow.
- The user asked you to run a specific named or saved workflow.

For any other task — even one that would clearly benefit from parallelism — do NOT call this tool. Use the Agent tool (if available) for individual subagents, or briefly describe what a multi-agent workflow could do and how much it would roughly cost, and ask the user whether to run it. Mention they can ask for one with "use a workflow" in a future message to skip the ask.

Every script must begin with `export const meta = {...}`: a PURE LITERAL (no variables, calls or interpolation) giving the workflow's `name`, a one-line `description` (shown in the permission dialog) and optionally `phases` — one `{ title, detail? }` per phase() call, titles matched exactly. Pass the script inline via `script` — do not Write it to a file first, and do not also set the tool's `name` input (that selects a saved workflow); it is plain JavaScript, not TypeScript.

The canonical multi-stage pattern — pipeline by default, each dimension verifies as soon as its review completes:
  export const meta = {
    name: 'review-changes',
    description: 'Review changed files across dimensions, verify each finding',
    phases: [{ title: 'Review' }, { title: 'Verify' }],
  }
  const DIMENSIONS = [{key: 'bugs', prompt: '...'}, {key: 'perf', prompt: '...'}]
  const results = await pipeline(
    DIMENSIONS,
    d => agent(d.prompt, {label: `review:${d.key}`, phase: 'Review', schema: FINDINGS_SCHEMA}),
    review => parallel(review.findings.map(f => () =>
      agent(`Adversarially verify: ${f.title}`, {label: `verify:${f.file}`, phase: 'Verify', schema: VERDICT_SCHEMA})
        .then(v => ({...f, verdict: v}))
    ))
  )
  const confirmed = results.flat().filter(Boolean).filter(f => f.verdict?.isReal)
  return { confirmed }
  // Dimension 'bugs' findings verify while dimension 'perf' is still reviewing. No wasted wall-clock.

Before writing a script, load the `workflow-authoring` skill — the workflow authoring reference: script API and gotchas, resume, the **Ultracode** section, quality patterns, worked examples.

This session has the default workflow size guideline: medium — keep workflows under 10 agents. This is a guideline, not a hard limit — follow it unless the user's prompt calls for a different scale. The user can raise or remove it with "Dynamic workflow size" in /config.

# WeakNet CLI (weaknet-cli) 使用手册

> **版本**：v1.0  
> **适用平台**：Radxa Cubie A7A (ARM64) / x86_64 开发机  
> **依赖**：systemd、D-Bus 系统总线、libweaknet.so

---

## 1. 概述

`weaknet-cli` 是 WeakNet 网络诊断平台的**命令行配置管理工具**，用于在开发板上**实时查询、修改监控器参数**，无需重启服务。它是 `libweaknet.so` C API 的薄封装，通过 D-Bus 系统总线与 `weaknet-dbus-server` 通信。

**核心能力**：
- 🔍 **查询**：实时获取任意监控器的完整参数（JSON 格式）
- ⚙️ **设置**：实时修改监控器参数（白名单校验、区间校验、原子提交）
- 📋 **列举**：列出所有可配置的监控器名称
- 📡 **事件查询**：查询已持久化的无线设备事件（断连等，只读）

> **关键特性**：运行时修改**仅影响内存态**，重启服务后自动回落到 `/etc/weaknet/config.yaml` 的启动配置。这是设计使然——配置文件是“启动快照”，CLI 是“运行时覆盖”。

---

## 2. 安装与前置条件

### 2.1 开发板部署（ARM64）

`weaknet-cli` 随 `tools/ci.sh` 自动打包进 `dist-arm64/client/bin/weaknet-cli`，并由 `tools/ci.sh` 部署到开发板：

```bash
# 开发板上的路径
/home/radxa/weaknet/client/bin/weaknet-cli
```

**依赖**：
- `libweaknet.so` 必须在系统库路径（`/usr/local/lib/`），由 `tools/ci.sh` 自动部署并 `ldconfig`
- D-Bus 系统总线（服务端运行在系统总线 `com.example.WeakNet`）

### 2.2 开发机验证（x86_64）

```bash
# 本地编译（不含 eBPF）
cmake -B build-x86 -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug -DBUILD_EBPF=OFF
cmake --build build-x86 -j$(nproc)

# 二进制位置
./build-x86/client/bin/weaknet_cli
```

> 注意：x86 版本需连接开发板的 D-Bus（或本地运行服务端）才能工作。

---

## 3. 命令参考

### 3.1 语法概览

```bash
weaknet-cli <command> [arguments...]

命令：
  get <monitor>          查询监控器当前参数（JSON）
  set <key> <value>      设置参数（白名单校验）
  list                   列出所有可用监控器名
  monitor list           列出所有监控器运行状态（JSON）
  monitor status [name]  查询监控器运行状态
  monitor enable <name>  启用并启动监控器
  monitor disable <name> 停止监控器
  monitor restart <name> 重启监控器
  monitor save           保存运行时启停状态到 override 文件
  events [过滤条件]       查询无线设备事件（Canonical Device Event，JSON）
  incidents [过滤条件]    查询区域级异常事件（SiteIncident，JSON）
  diagnosis              查询当前网络确定性诊断事实（DiagnosisFacts，JSON）
  experience             查询当前网络体验权威快照（NetworkExperience Schema v2，JSON）
  action <action_id> [<key> <val>] 执行白名单安全排查动作（仅限 root）
```

`events` 的过滤条件全部可选，省略即不限制：

```
  --device <addr>       设备地址过滤（XX:XX:XX:XX:XX:XX）
  --type <EVENT_TYPE>   事件类型过滤（如 LINK_DISCONNECTED）
  --start <ms>          起始时间（Unix 毫秒，0 表示不限）
  --end <ms>            结束时间（Unix 毫秒，0 表示不限）
  --limit <N>           最大条数（默认 100，服务端上限 10000）

# OTA Phase 1 本地升级（板端闭环）

> 日期：2026-10-19
> 分类：工作流外实施（用户明确指示不走 OpenSpec change）
> 结果：已完成（本地全量验证 + 沙盒演练通过；真机演练待用户批准部署后补记）

## 构思

当前板端升级靠 `tools/ci.sh` 从开发机 rsync `--delete` 覆盖：无版本概念、无原子性、无回滚，两块板以上即不可运维。仓库已有可复用地基（`ConfigTransaction` 180s 试用看门狗、`EVP_DigestVerify` 验签模式、`HealthCheck`/`GetEbpfMonitorHealth` 健康判据、ActionRegistry 目录指纹契约），但 OTA 本身零实现。

Phase 1 目标：**板端本地闭环**——解包校验 → 版本单调检查 → 原子切换 → 重启 → 健康窗口 → 转正/自动回滚，零云端依赖。这是后续云侧制品链（Phase 2，Ed25519 发布密钥 + 制品下发）与审批执行链（Phase 3）的前置地基。

不走 OpenSpec change 的原因：用户明确选择工作流外实施；改动面为新增文件为主（VERSION、update_status 模块、升级脚本、CLI 子命令）+ 部署路径适配（service/ci.sh），属运维地基建设而非产品行为规格变更。按铁律在本目录留记录。

## 实现方式

**版本与布局**
- 新增根 `VERSION`（一行 semver `1.0.0`），CMake 读入 `project(weaknet VERSION ...)`。
- 板端布局：`releases/<version>/{server,client,lib,...,VERSION,manifest.sha256,.committed}`，`current -> releases/<version>` 为原子翻转点（`ln -sfn` + `mv -Tf`），`server`/`client`/`lib` 等兼容软链 → `current/*` 保持历史路径有效。
- `data/` 下 5 个状态文件与 `/etc/weaknet/config.yaml` 升级全程只读。

**C++ 侧（server）**
- 新增 `server/{include,src}/update_status.{hpp,cpp}`：IsValidVersion / CompareVersions / IsUpgradeAllowed（`dpkg --compare-versions` 语义，拒绝降级）/ ParseManifestLine（拒绝对路径与 `..` 穿越）/ ReadCurrentVersion（readlink）/ VerifyReleaseIntegrity（OpenSSL EVP 流式 sha256，无 TLS 构建降级 NO_CAPABILITY）/ StatusJson。
- `GetUpdateStatus` 只读 D-Bus 方法（无需 root），上报 installed_version / layout / pending / committed。
- `server/test/unit/test_update_status_gtest.cpp`：4 纯逻辑 + 7 文件 I/O 用例（mkdtemp 隔离，fixture sha 由本机 sha256sum 钉死）。

**升级执行体（shell）**
- 新增 `tools/weaknet-local-update.sh`：`status/verify/apply/rollback/adopt/package` 六子命令。apply：解包（tar.zst/gz/tar）→ Ed25519 验签（占位：无公钥告警放行，有公钥 fail-closed）→ 版本策略 → 翻转 + 重启 → 健康窗口（服务 active + HealthCheck + GetEbpfMonitorHealth + **GetUpdateStatus 版本一致**防假绿灯，连续 3 次）→ `.committed` 转正；失败自动回滚 `.previous`（同版本旧副本保留到转正才删，flip 失败先恢复）。
- 诊断一律走 stderr，stdout 只留可捕获数据；`sha256sum -c` 输出显式丢弃（实测踩过 FAILED 行污染命令替换）。

**CLI 薄封装**
- `weaknet-cli update status` 走 D-Bus；`apply/rollback/verify` fork+exec 升级脚本（不经 D-Bus——服务端不能调用中途重启自己），apply/rollback 要求 root。

**部署链切换**
- `tools/weaknet-server.service`：ExecStart/WorkingDirectory 经 `current` 寻址。
- `tools/ci.sh`：产物追加 VERSION + 升级脚本；部署改走 `.deploy-staging` + `adopt releases/${VERSION}`（不再 rsync 直接覆盖 server/，restart 由 adopt 翻转后执行）；停服清理收窄，避免经兼容软链误删 `.release` 的 `.bpf.o`。
- 文档同步：`docs/weaknet_cli_usage.md` 新增 3.10 `update` 子命令章节 + 语法概览 + 版本历史。

**验证手段**
- x86 全量：`cmake --build build-x86 && ctest --test-dir build-x86/server` → **53/53 通过**（含新增 test_update_status_gtest 11 用例，无回归）。
- `bash -n` 两个脚本通过。
- 本地沙盒演练（`/tmp/wn-ota-drill`，`WEAKNET_UPDATE_DRYRUN=1` 跳过 systemctl/busctl）**10 场景全通过**：package 打包、verify 校验、首次 apply、status 查询、篡改包拒绝、同版本幂等重装、正常升级、降级拒绝、`--allow-downgrade` 放行、rollback、adopt 旧布局迁移 + data 隔离。

## 结果

Phase 1 代码主体完成并本地验证。真机部署演练（篡改拒绝 / 幂等 / 升级回滚 / data 完好 / catalog 无漂移）尚未执行——部署需用户明确批准，批准后走 `./tools/ci.sh` 并补记结论。

遗留与后续：
- Ed25519 发布密钥 Phase 2 接入（当前无公钥时告警放行，非强制）。
- 云侧制品链（Phase 2）与审批执行链（Phase 3）另立项。
- 首次板端部署会触发 legacy-flat → releases 布局迁移（adopt 自动归档），真机演练时重点观察。

# 解包 + 校验 + 版本策略 → 输出 staging 目录路径。$1=pkg $2=allow_downgrade
stage_package() {
    local pkg="$1" allow="${2:-0}"
    [ -f "$pkg" ] || fail "升级包不存在：$pkg"
    verify_signature "$pkg"
    local cur; cur="$(current_version)"
    local staging="$RELEASES/.staging.$$"
    rm -rf "$staging"; mkdir -p "$staging"
    case "$pkg" in
        *.tar.zst|*.tzst) tar --zstd -xf "$pkg" -C "$staging" ;;
        *.tar.gz|*.tgz)   tar -zxf "$pkg" -C "$staging" ;;
        *.tar)            tar -xf "$pkg" -C "$staging" ;;
        *) rm -rf "$staging"; fail "不支持的包格式：$pkg（需 tar.zst/tar.gz/tar）" ;;
    esac
    local ver
    # 显式接住校验失败：函数内的 fail 在命令替换子 shell 里只体现为非零退出码，
    # 不加 || 会穿透 set -e 继续执行（实测踩过）
    ver="$(verify_release_dir "$staging")" || { rm -rf "$staging"; exit 1; }
    if ! version_allowed "$cur" "$ver" "$allow"; then
        rm -rf "$staging"
        fail "版本策略拒绝：current=${cur:-无} → target=${ver}（降级需 --allow-downgrade）"
    fi
    echo "$staging"
}

cmd_package() {  # <dist-dir> <version> <out.tar.zst>
    local dist="$1" ver="$2" out="$3"
    [ -d "$dist" ] || fail "dist 目录不存在：$dist"
    valid_version "$ver" || fail "版本号非法：$ver（需 X.Y.Z）"
    echo "$ver" > "$dist/VERSION"
    if [ -f "$0" ]; then install -m 0755 "$0" "$dist/weaknet-local-update.sh"; fi
    (cd "$dist" && find . -type f ! -name manifest.sha256 -print0 \
        | sed -z 's|^\./||' | sort -z | xargs -0 sha256sum > manifest.sha256)
    mkdir -p "$(dirname "$out")"
    tar --zstd -cf "$out" -C "$dist" .
