#!/usr/bin/env bash
# ============================================================================
# WeakNet CI 自动化脚本（唯一入口）
#
# 编译 → 打包 → 部署 → 测试
#
# 用法:
#   ./tools/ci.sh                    # 日常：编译+部署+测试
#   ./tools/ci.sh --commit           # 归档后：commit+push+编译+部署+测试
#   ./tools/ci.sh --local-only       # 只编译不部署
#   ./tools/ci.sh --skip-push        # 不 push
#   ./tools/ci.sh --skip-deploy      # 不部署
#   ./tools/ci.sh --skip-test        # 不测试
#
# 环境变量:
#   SYSROOT_DIR - ARM64 Sysroot 路径（默认: /opt/sysroot-bullseye-arm64）
#   BOARD       - 开发板 SSH 地址（默认: radxa@radxa-cubie-a7a.local 或 board）
# ============================================================================
set -euo pipefail

# ---- 配置 ----
SYSROOT_DIR="${SYSROOT_DIR:-/opt/sysroot-bullseye-arm64}"
BOARD="${BOARD:-radxa@radxa-cubie-a7a.local}"
ROOT="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)"
DIST_DIR="${ROOT}/dist-arm64"
REPORT_DIR="${ROOT}/ci-reports"
TIMESTAMP=$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S)

# ---- 参数解析 ----
DO_COMMIT=false
LOCAL_ONLY=false
SKIP_PUSH=false
SKIP_DEPLOY=false
SKIP_TEST=false
for arg in "$@"; do
    case $arg in
        --commit) DO_COMMIT=true ;;
        --local-only) LOCAL_ONLY=true; SKIP_PUSH=true; SKIP_DEPLOY=true; SKIP_TEST=true ;;
        --skip-push) SKIP_PUSH=true ;;
        --skip-deploy) SKIP_DEPLOY=true ;;
        --skip-test) SKIP_TEST=true ;;
        --help|-h)
            echo "用法: $0 [--commit] [--local-only] [--skip-push] [--skip-deploy] [--skip-test]"
            echo ""
            echo "  --commit      git commit + push（归档后使用）"
            echo "  --local-only  只编译不部署"
            echo "  --skip-push   不 push"
            echo "  --skip-deploy 不部署到开发板"
            echo "  --skip-test   不运行开发板测试"
            echo ""
            echo "环境变量:"
            echo "  SYSROOT_DIR=路径   ARM64 Bullseye Sysroot（默认: /opt/sysroot-bullseye-arm64）"
            echo "  BOARD=主机或别名   开发板地址（默认: radxa@radxa-cubie-a7a.local 或 board）"
            exit 0
            ;;
        *) echo "未知参数: $arg"; exit 1 ;;
    esac
done

# ---- 颜色 ----
RED='\033[0;31m'; GREEN='\033[0;32m'; YELLOW='\033[1;33m'; CYAN='\033[0;36m'; NC='\033[0m'
pass() { echo -e "${GREEN}✅ $1${NC}"; }
fail() { echo -e "${RED}❌ $1${NC}"; exit 1; }
info() { echo -e "${CYAN}ℹ️  $1${NC}"; }
warn() { echo -e "${YELLOW}⚠️  $1${NC}"; }

# ---- 创建报告目录 ----
mkdir -p "${REPORT_DIR}"
REPORT="${REPORT_DIR}/ci_${TIMESTAMP}.txt"
log() { echo "$1" | tee -a "$REPORT"; }

# ---- 版本单一来源（仓库根 VERSION，OTA releases/<version> 与包名都用它） ----
VERSION="$(tr -d '[:space:]' < "${ROOT}/VERSION" 2>/dev/null || echo "")"
if ! [[ "${VERSION}" =~ ^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$ ]]; then
    fail "仓库根 VERSION 缺失或非法（需一行 X.Y.Z）：'${VERSION}'"
fi

# ============================================================
log "=============================================="
log "  WeakNet CI — $(date)"
log "=============================================="

# ============================================================
# Step 1: Git commit + push（可选）
# ============================================================
if [ "$DO_COMMIT" = true ]; then
    log ""
    log "===== Step 1: Git 提交 ====="

    if [ -n "$(git status --porcelain)" ]; then
        cd "$ROOT"
        # S9 残留修复：本机常有多个会话共享同一 worktree，`git add -A` 会把
        # 其它会话的未跟踪文件（WIP 源码、临时二进制、VERSION 之类）一并扫进
        # 归档提交。改为两级：-u 只暂存已跟踪文件的改动/删除；新增文件仅放行
        # openspec/（归档把 changes/<name> 移动为 archive/<name> 时产生的新
        # 路径都在其下，含 ai_snapshot.json 之外的全部归档产物）。
        git add -u
        git add openspec/
        if ! git diff --cached --quiet; then
            git commit -m "chore: harness 归档后全量提交

$(git diff --cached --stat | tail -1)"
            pass "提交完成"
        else
            info "无已跟踪改动或 openspec 新增文件，无需提交"
        fi
    else
        info "工作区干净，无需提交"
    fi

    if [ "$SKIP_PUSH" = false ]; then
        BRANCH=$(git branch --show-current)
        cd "$ROOT"
        git push origin "$BRANCH" && pass "推送成功" || fail "推送失败"
    else
        info "跳过推送"
    fi
fi

# ============================================================
# Step 2: ARM64 编译 + 打包（宿主机原生交叉编译）
# ============================================================
log ""
log "===== Step 2: ARM64 编译 + 打包 ====="

# 使用宿主机裸机原生交叉编译（/opt/sysroot-bullseye-arm64 + clang -j$(nproc)），
# 完全脱离 QEMU 模拟与 Docker 容器，耗时从 ~15 分钟降至 ~40 秒。
BUILD_STATUS=0
if [ ! -d "${SYSROOT_DIR}" ] || [ ! -f "${ROOT}/cmake/toolchain-arm64-cross.cmake" ]; then
    fail "缺少 Sysroot (${SYSROOT_DIR}) 或工具链文件。请先运行 sudo ./scripts/setup_arm64_sysroot.sh 初始化"
fi

info "使用宿主机裸机原生交叉编译 (Clang + Bullseye Sysroot, -j$(nproc))"
(
    set -euo pipefail
    cd "${ROOT}"

    echo "--- CMake 配置（宿主机原生交叉编译）---"
    cmake -B build-arm64-native \
          -DCMAKE_TOOLCHAIN_FILE=cmake/toolchain-arm64-cross.cmake \
          -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug \
          -DBUILD_EBPF=ON 2>&1

    echo "--- 编译服务端 + eBPF + 客户端 (-j$(nproc)) ---"
    cmake --build build-arm64-native --target weaknet-dbus-server history_query_tool weaknet weaknet_cli test_client_bin test_ebpf ebpf -j"$(nproc)" 2>&1

    echo "--- 打包 dist-arm64 ---"
    rm -rf dist-arm64
    mkdir -p dist-arm64/server/bin dist-arm64/server/build dist-arm64/server/test \
             dist-arm64/client/bin dist-arm64/client/lib dist-arm64/lib

    install -m 0755 build-arm64-native/server/weaknet-dbus-server dist-arm64/server/bin/
    install -m 0755 build-arm64-native/server/history_query_tool dist-arm64/server/bin/
    install -m 0755 build-arm64-native/server/test/test_ebpf dist-arm64/server/test/
    for f in build-arm64-native/server/build/*.bpf.o; do install -m 0644 "$f" dist-arm64/server/build/ 2>/dev/null || true; done
    install -m 0755 build-arm64-native/client/bin/test_client_bin dist-arm64/client/bin/test-client
    install -m 0755 build-arm64-native/client/bin/weaknet_cli dist-arm64/client/bin/weaknet-cli
    install -m 0755 client/weaknet-offline-diag dist-arm64/client/bin/weaknet-offline-diag
    install -m 0644 build-arm64-native/client/lib/libweaknet.so dist-arm64/client/lib/
    install -m 0755 "AI-assisted analysis/edge_network_rag.py" dist-arm64/edge_network_rag.py
    install -m 0644 "AI-assisted analysis/network_knowledge_base.py" dist-arm64/network_knowledge_base.py
    cp -a "${SYSROOT_DIR}/usr/local/lib/libbpf.so"* dist-arm64/lib/ 2>/dev/null || true

    # OTA 发布物：VERSION 与升级脚本随包下发；manifest.sha256 由板端 adopt
    # 现场按实际落地文件生成（包路径与板端部署内容必然一致）。
    install -m 0644 "${ROOT}/VERSION" dist-arm64/VERSION
    install -m 0755 "${ROOT}/tools/weaknet-local-update.sh" dist-arm64/weaknet-local-update.sh

    echo "产物: $(find dist-arm64 -type f | wc -l) 个文件"
    file dist-arm64/server/bin/weaknet-dbus-server

    echo "--- ccache 统计 ---"
    if command -v ccache >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        ccache -s 2>/dev/null | grep -E "cache hit|cache miss|hit rate|files in cache|cache size" || true
    fi
) 2>&1 | tee -a "$REPORT" || BUILD_STATUS=${PIPESTATUS[0]}

if [ "$BUILD_STATUS" -ne 0 ]; then
    fail "ARM64 编译/打包失败（退出码 ${BUILD_STATUS}）——中止：不打印成功、不进入部署，板端保持旧版本"
fi
pass "编译 + 打包完成"

if [ "$LOCAL_ONLY" = true ]; then
    log ""
    pass "本地编译完成（跳过部署）"
    exit 0
fi

# ============================================================
# Step 3: 部署到开发板
# ============================================================
if [ "$SKIP_DEPLOY" = false ]; then
    log ""
    log "===== Step 3: 部署到开发板 ====="

    if [ "${BOARD}" != "board" ] && ! ping -c 1 -W 2 "${BOARD#*@}" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        fail "开发板不可达"
    fi

    # 停服 + 清理 __pycache__（root 属主 .pyc，radxa 用户无法 unlink，
    # 曾导致 rsync --delete 恒失败，实测踩过 3 次）。
    # 不再删除旧扁平布局的 server/client 子目录：首次 adopt 会把整个旧布局
    # 归档为 releases/legacy-flat——在兼容软链建立后直接 rm server/build
    # 会经软链误删当前 release 的 .bpf.o（OTA 布局切换期的坑）。
    ssh "${BOARD}" "sudo systemctl stop weaknet-server 2>/dev/null || true; sudo killall weaknet-dbus-server 2>/dev/null || true; sudo rm -rf /home/radxa/weaknet/__pycache__ 2>/dev/null || true"

    # 只同步 dist-arm64 编译产物到暂存目录（不碰 releases/current/data/config），
    # 由下方 weaknet-local-update.sh adopt 原子迁入 releases/${VERSION}。
    # 旧版遗留的 data/、config/、日志与本次 rsync 彻底解耦（不再依赖 exclude 保护）。
    rsync -az --delete -e ssh "${DIST_DIR}/" "${BOARD}:/home/radxa/weaknet/.deploy-staging/" \
        || fail "rsync 部署失败——板端可能仍是旧产物"

    # 旧 web-dashboard 已废弃删除：前端统一由 Large-Model-Application（Next.js）承载，
    # 开发板只保留 eBPF + C++ 底座。此处顺带停用并清理板上遗留的 weaknet-web 服务，
    # 避免旧 unit 继续拉起已失去部署来源的旧网关。
    ssh "${BOARD}" "sudo systemctl disable --now weaknet-web 2>/dev/null || true; \
        sudo rm -f /etc/systemd/system/weaknet-web.service 2>/dev/null || true; \
        sudo rm -rf /home/radxa/weaknet/web 2>/dev/null || true; \
        sudo systemctl daemon-reload 2>/dev/null || true"

    # 部署 systemd 单元、D-Bus 系统总线策略、运行时配置并启动服务实例
    scp "${ROOT}/tools/weaknet-server.service" "${BOARD}:/tmp/weaknet-server.service" 2>/dev/null
    scp "${ROOT}/tools/com.example.WeakNet.conf" "${BOARD}:/tmp/com.example.WeakNet.conf" 2>/dev/null
    # S5：Edge 预共享令牌通过安全通道渲染并直接安装到 /etc/weaknet/config.yaml（0600），
    # 绝不写入 /tmp（消除世界可读窗口），且 token 绝不进入远程命令 argv（ps 可见风险）。
    EDGE_TOKEN_FILE="${ROOT}/secrets/edge_token"
    [[ -s "${EDGE_TOKEN_FILE}" ]] || fail "缺少 ${EDGE_TOKEN_FILE}（edge 上行预共享令牌），先创建该文件再部署"
    EDGE_TOKEN="$(tr -d '[:space:]' < "${EDGE_TOKEN_FILE}")"
    [[ "${EDGE_TOKEN}" =~ ^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$ ]] || fail "secrets/edge_token 含非法字符（仅允许 [A-Za-z0-9_-]）"
    RENDERED_CONFIG="$(mktemp "${ROOT}/.ci-config-XXXXXX.yaml")"
    chmod 0600 "${RENDERED_CONFIG}"
    sed "s|^  token: \"\"$|  token: \"${EDGE_TOKEN}\"|" config.yaml > "${RENDERED_CONFIG}"
    ssh "${BOARD}" "sudo mkdir -p /etc/weaknet && sudo install -m 0600 /dev/stdin /etc/weaknet/config.yaml" < "${RENDERED_CONFIG}" || {
        shred -u "${RENDERED_CONFIG}" 2>/dev/null || rm -f "${RENDERED_CONFIG}"
        fail "edge token 注入板端失败（stdin → /etc/weaknet/config.yaml）"
    }
    shred -u "${RENDERED_CONFIG}" 2>/dev/null || rm -f "${RENDERED_CONFIG}"
    pass "edge token 已安全注入 /etc/weaknet/config.yaml（0600，不进 argv/tmp）"

    # 客户端动态库安装到系统路径，供 weaknet-cli 链接（服务端走 unit 内 LD_LIBRARY_PATH）
    scp "${DIST_DIR}/client/lib/libweaknet.so" "${BOARD}:/tmp/libweaknet.so" 2>/dev/null
    # OTA Phase 2：分发发布公钥到板端 config 目录（供 weaknet-local-update 强制验签）
    if [ -f "${ROOT}/certs/release_pub.pem" ]; then
        scp "${ROOT}/certs/release_pub.pem" "${BOARD}:/tmp/release_pub.pem" 2>/dev/null
        ssh "${BOARD}" "sudo mkdir -p /home/radxa/weaknet/config && sudo cp /tmp/release_pub.pem /home/radxa/weaknet/config/release_pub.pem && sudo chmod 644 /home/radxa/weaknet/config/release_pub.pem"
        pass "发布公钥已同步到板端 config/release_pub.pem"
    fi
    ssh "${BOARD}" "sudo cp /tmp/weaknet-server.service /etc/systemd/system/weaknet-server.service && \
        sudo cp /tmp/com.example.WeakNet.conf /etc/dbus-1/system.d/com.example.WeakNet.conf && \
        sudo cp /tmp/libweaknet.so /usr/local/lib/libweaknet.so && sudo ldconfig && \
        sudo chmod o+rx /home/radxa/weaknet/data 2>/dev/null || true && \
        sudo systemctl daemon-reload && sudo systemctl reload dbus 2>/dev/null || true; \
        sudo systemctl enable weaknet-server"
    # 注意：此处刻意不 restart——重启由 adopt 在 current 翻转之后执行，
    # 否则新 unit（current/server 路径）在布局未就位时会拉起失败。

    # 反向隧道单元：仓库里有唯一权威版本（tools/weaknet-tunnel.service），
    # 部署时顺手清掉板端历史遗留的 cloud-tunnel.service —— 两个单元都占
    # 板端 -L 8000 端口，后启动者必报 "Address already in use" 反复重启，
    # 云端 2222 反向端口随之失效（表现为 ssh board 全面连不上）。
    #
    # 顺序要求：隧道单元的重启会短暂掐断 SSH 反向通道，本条命令的后半段
    # （adopt → 重启服务 → 健康窗口）都走同一条 SSH 通道，必须放在**隧道
    # 重启之前**完成，否则连接会在通道重建途中被掐断（实测：Connection
    # closed by remote host，后续 adopt 步骤整段没跑，服务停在 inactive）。
    # 所以这里只做"清历史单元 + 落盘新单元"，隧道重启交给 deploy 收尾。
    if [ -f "${ROOT}/tools/weaknet-tunnel.service" ]; then
        scp "${ROOT}/tools/weaknet-tunnel.service" "${BOARD}:/tmp/weaknet-tunnel.service" 2>/dev/null
        ssh "${BOARD}" "sudo cp /tmp/weaknet-tunnel.service /etc/systemd/system/weaknet-tunnel.service && \
            sudo systemctl disable --now cloud-tunnel.service 2>/dev/null || true; \
            sudo rm -f /etc/systemd/system/cloud-tunnel.service && \
            sudo systemctl daemon-reload && \
            sudo systemctl enable weaknet-tunnel.service" \
            || warn "反向隧道单元落盘失败（板端 tunnel 可能仍连不上云端）"
        pass "反向隧道单元已落盘（cloud-tunnel 历史单元已清理）"
    fi

    # OTA 布局迁移/切换（板端重启唯一入口）：暂存产物 → releases/${VERSION}
    # →（首次）旧扁平布局归档 legacy-flat → 原子翻转 current + 兼容软链
    # → 重启 → 健康窗口（失败自动回滚上一版）→ .committed 转正。
    scp "${ROOT}/tools/weaknet-local-update.sh" "${BOARD}:/tmp/weaknet-local-update.sh" 2>/dev/null
    ssh "${BOARD}" "sudo install -m 0755 /tmp/weaknet-local-update.sh /home/radxa/weaknet/weaknet-local-update.sh && \
        sudo WEAKNET_ROOT=/home/radxa/weaknet /home/radxa/weaknet/weaknet-local-update.sh adopt /home/radxa/weaknet/.deploy-staging ${VERSION}" \
        || fail "adopt 失败（布局迁移/健康窗口未通过，已自动回滚）——依据上方输出排查，必要时 sudo weaknet-cli update rollback"
    pass "部署完成（releases/${VERSION} 已转正）"

    # 测试脚本上传失败不能让 set -e 在部署收尾处静默杀死整个脚本
    # （真机踩过：板端残留 root 属主旧文件 → scp EACCES → 后续步骤全没跑）
    scp "${ROOT}/tools/weaknet-test-full.sh" "${BOARD}:/home/radxa/weaknet/weaknet-test-full.sh" 2>/dev/null \
        || warn "weaknet-test-full.sh 上传失败（板端文件可能属主异常：rm 后重试）"
    ssh "${BOARD}" "chmod +x /home/radxa/weaknet/weaknet-test-full.sh" 2>/dev/null \
        || warn "weaknet-test-full.sh chmod 失败"
    pass "部署完成"
else
    info "跳过部署"
fi

# ============================================================
# Step 4: 开发板测试
# ============================================================
if [ "$SKIP_TEST" = false ]; then
    log ""
    log "===== Step 4: 开发板测试 ====="

    # 上传测试脚本（失败不致命：下面的运行会因文件缺失显式报错）
    scp "${ROOT}/tools/weaknet-test-full.sh" "${BOARD}:/home/radxa/weaknet/weaknet-test-full.sh" 2>/dev/null \
        || warn "weaknet-test-full.sh 上传失败（板端文件可能属主异常：rm 后重试）"
    ssh "${BOARD}" "chmod +x /home/radxa/weaknet/weaknet-test-full.sh" 2>/dev/null \
        || warn "weaknet-test-full.sh chmod 失败"

    # 运行测试（weaknet-test-full.sh 以 FAIL 条数作为退出码）
    #  - 完整输出存报告，控制台只显示前 80 行（截断只是显示，不再是取证上限）
    #  - 退出码必须捕获：旧写法 `|| true` 会吞掉失败，然后无条件打印
    #    "测试完成"，冒烟挂了 CI 也报成功——与构建失败同级的发布可信度缺陷
    FUNC_RESULT=""
    TEST_EXIT=0
    FUNC_RESULT=$(ssh -t "${BOARD}" "sudo /home/radxa/weaknet/weaknet-test-full.sh" 2>&1) || TEST_EXIT=$?
    printf '%s\n' "$FUNC_RESULT" >> "$REPORT"
    # head 提前退出会让 printf 吃 SIGPIPE(141)；pipefail + set -e 会因此误报失败，
    # 所以显示用的管道必须放行（报告里已有完整输出，截断只是显示）
    printf '%s\n' "$FUNC_RESULT" | head -80 || true

    # 解析结果
    # 显示用解析：grep 无匹配时不能让 set -e 把已通过的测试判成失败
    HEALTH_JSON=$(echo "$FUNC_RESULT" | grep "健康检查结果" | head -1 | sed 's/.*: //' || true)
    if [ -n "$HEALTH_JSON" ]; then
        log ""
        log "功能测试结果:"
        log "  接口: $(echo "$HEALTH_JSON" | grep -o '"interface":"[^"]*"' | cut -d'"' -f4)"
        log "  质量分数: $(echo "$HEALTH_JSON" | grep -o '"quality_score":[0-9.]*' | cut -d: -f2)"
        log "  RTT: $(echo "$HEALTH_JSON" | grep -o '"rtt_ms":[0-9-]*' | cut -d: -f2) ms"
        log "  RSSI: $(echo "$HEALTH_JSON" | grep -o '"rssi_dbm":[0-9-]*' | cut -d: -f2) dBm"
    fi

    # 双保险：退出码 + 输出里的 FAIL 计数
    FAIL_COUNT=$(printf '%s' "$FUNC_RESULT" | grep -oE 'FAIL: [0-9]+' | grep -oE '[0-9]+' | tail -1 || true)
    if [ "${TEST_EXIT}" -ne 0 ] || [ "${FAIL_COUNT:-0}" -gt 0 ]; then
        fail "开发板测试失败（退出码 ${TEST_EXIT}，FAIL=${FAIL_COUNT:-未知}）"
    fi
    pass "测试完成"
else
    info "跳过测试"
fi

# ============================================================
log ""
log "=============================================="
pass "全部完成"
log "=============================================="

# OTA Phase 1 本地升级 — 实施计划

## Context

为什么做：当前板端升级靠 `tools/ci.sh` 从开发机 rsync 覆盖（`--delete`），无版本概念、无原子性、无回滚。两块板以上即不可运维。OTA Phase 1 只做**板端本地闭环**（解包校验 → 原子切换 → 健康窗口 → 自动回滚），零云端依赖，是后续云侧制品链（Phase 2）与审批执行链（Phase 3）的前置地基，也是运维刚需。

用户已选：OTA Phase 1 本地升级（DPDK 学习实验与 ideas-only 备选已搁置）。本计划只覆盖 Phase 1；Phase 2/3 另立 change。

前置事实（只读调研已确认）：
- 板端布局：`/home/radxa/weaknet/`（server/bin、server/build/*.bpf.o、data/、config/），服务单元 `tools/weaknet-server.service`（`ExecStart=…/server/bin/weaknet-dbus-server --config /etc/weaknet/config.yaml`，`WorkingDirectory=…/server`，root + 5 capabilities）。
- `dist-arm64/` 结构：server/bin、server/build、server/test、client/bin、client/lib、lib（28MB，zstd 后约 10MB）。
- 升级必须原位保留的 5 个状态文件：`data/history.db`、`data/network-epoch`、`data/wireless-uplink-state`、`data/runtime-overrides.bin`、`data/config_txn_state`（路径解析 `server/include/common.hpp`）。
- 可复用模式：`ConfigTransaction` 180s 试用看门狗（`server/include/weaknet_config.hpp:343`、`server/src/weaknet_config.cpp:1073`，tmp+rename 持久化 + 开机崩溃回滚）；板端下行 `EVP_DigestVerify` 验签模式（`server/src/edge_telemetry_exporter.cpp:679`）；健康判据 `HealthCheck`/`GetEbpfMonitorHealth`（`server/src/dbus_service.cpp:394,1348`）。
- 无版本来源：`config.yaml`、CMake（`project(weaknet VERSION 1.0.0)` 静态）、`WeakNetConfig` 均无固件版本键。`ai_snapshot.json` 为 idle，无 active change，可新建 change。

## 推荐方案（只写这一个，不展开备选）

**独立 shell 脚本 + CLI 薄封装 + 服务端只读状态方法**，releases 目录 + `current` 软链接原子翻转：

```
板端 /home/radxa/weaknet/
├── releases/<version>/   # server/ client/ lib/ + manifest.json（sha256 清单 + 版本）
├── current -> releases/<version>   # 原子翻转点（rename）
├── data/                 # 5 个状态文件，升级永不触碰
└── config/               # edge_priv.pem，升级永不触碰
```

1. **版本单一来源**：仓库根新增 `VERSION` 文件（一行 semver）。CMake 读入编译进二进制（`--version` 输出）；`ci.sh --release`（或本地打包命令）用它给 manifest 盖戳；服务端新增只读 D-Bus 方法 `GetUpdateStatus` 上报当前版本 + slot 状态。单调递增检查拒绝降级（防回滚攻击的本地版）。
2. **包格式**：`weaknet-<version>.tar.zst` + `manifest.json`（文件→sha256、版本、最低兼容标记）。Phase 1 做 sha256 全量校验 + 版本单调检查；Ed25519 分离式签名**验签位先占后实现**（验签函数按 `edge_telemetry_exporter.cpp:679` 的 `EVP_DigestVerify` 模式写，若发布公钥不存在则告警通过——避免 Phase 2 返工，不阻塞 Phase 1 闭环）。
3. **执行体**：新增 `tools/weaknet-local-update.sh`（`apply/status/rollback/verify` 四子命令，随包部署到板）。`weaknet-cli` 新增 `update` 子命令，**apply/rollback 直接 fork+exec 该脚本**（不停留 D-Bus——服务端不能在调用中途杀死自己），`update status` 走 D-Bus `GetUpdateStatus` 只读查询。root 限权沿用现有 `requireRootCaller` 惯例。
4. **原子切换**：解包到 `releases/<version>/` → 校验 → `ln -sfn` 到临时名 → `rename` 翻转 `current` → `systemctl restart weaknet-server`。服务单元改为经 `current` 寻址（`ExecStart` + `WorkingDirectory` 同步改，`bpf_obj` 相对路径解析随工作目录走——实现时以 `server.cpp` 实际解析逻辑为准，必要时改为绝对路径）。
5. **健康窗口 + 自动回滚**：重启后脚本轮询（默认 180s，复用看门狗窗口语义）：D-Bus `HealthCheck` 有响应 + `GetEbpfMonitorHealth` 探针 attach 数正常 + 进程存活。全绿则 commit（写 `releases/<version>/.committed` 标记）；任一失败则翻回上一版 symlink 并重启。`data/` 与 `/etc/weaknet/config.yaml` 全程只读。
6. **目录漂移清单**：任何改动 `ActionRegistry`/trial 白名单的版本，发布 checklist 必须含"云端同步审阅目录"（`docs/网关动作目录版本契约.md` fail-closed 防线，否则升级后远程动作全被自拦）。

tools.description:
Use this tool only when you are blocked on a decision that is genuinely the user's to make: one you cannot resolve from the request, the code, or sensible defaults.

Usage notes:
- Users will always be able to select "Other" to provide custom text input
- Use multiSelect: true to allow multiple answers to be selected for a question
- If you recommend a specific option, make that the first option in the list and add "(Recommended)" at the end of the label

Plan mode note: To switch into plan mode, use EnterPlanMode (not this tool). Once in plan mode, use this tool to clarify requirements or choose between approaches BEFORE finalizing your plan. Do NOT use this tool to ask "Is my plan ready?", "Should I proceed?", or otherwise reference "the plan" in questions — the user cannot see the plan until you call ExitPlanMode for approval.

Reserve this for decisions where the user's answer changes what you do next — not for choices with a conventional default or facts you can verify in the codebase yourself. In those cases pick the obvious option, mention it in your response, and proceed.

Preview feature:
Use the optional `preview` field on options when presenting concrete artifacts that users need to visually compare:
- ASCII mockups of UI layouts or components
- Code snippets showing different implementations
- Diagram variations
- Configuration examples

When any option has a preview, the UI switches to a side-by-side layout with a vertical option list on the left and preview on the right. Do not use previews for simple preference questions where labels and descriptions suffice. Note: previews are only supported for single-select questions (not multiSelect).

tools.name: CronCreate
tools.description:
Schedule a prompt to be enqueued at a future time. Use for both recurring schedules and one-shot reminders.

Uses standard 5-field cron in the user's local timezone: minute hour day-of-month month day-of-week. "0 9 * * *" means 9am local — no timezone conversion needed.

## One-shot tasks (recurring: false)

For "remind me at X" or "at <time>, do Y" requests — fire once then auto-delete.
Pin minute/hour/day-of-month/month to specific values:
  "remind me at 2:30pm today to check the deploy" → cron: "30 14 <today_dom> <today_month> *", recurring: false
  "tomorrow morning, run the smoke test" → cron: "57 8 <tomorrow_dom> <tomorrow_month> *", recurring: false

## Recurring jobs (recurring: true, the default)

For "every N minutes" / "every hour" / "weekdays at 9am" requests:
  "*/5 * * * *" (every 5 min), "0 * * * *" (hourly), "0 9 * * 1-5" (weekdays at 9am local)

## Avoid the :00 and :30 minute marks when the task allows it

Every user who asks for "9am" gets `0 9`, and every user who asks for "hourly" gets `0 *` — which means requests from across the planet land on the API at the same instant. When the user's request is approximate, pick a minute that is NOT 0 or 30:
  "every morning around 9" → "57 8 * * *" or "3 9 * * *" (not "0 9 * * *")
  "hourly" → "7 * * * *" (not "0 * * * *")
  "in an hour or so, remind me to..." → pick whatever minute you land on, don't round

Only use minute 0 or 30 when the user names that exact time and clearly means it ("at 9:00 sharp", "at half past", coordinating with a meeting). When in doubt, nudge a few minutes early or late — the user will not notice, and the fleet will.

## Durability

By default (durable: false) the job lives only in this Claude session — nothing is written to disk, and the job is gone when Claude exits. Pass durable: true to write to .claude/scheduled_tasks.json so the job survives restarts. Only use durable: true when the user explicitly asks for the task to persist ("keep doing this every day", "set this up permanently"). Most "remind me in 5 minutes" / "check back in an hour" requests should stay session-only.

## Runtime behavior

Jobs only fire while the REPL is idle (not mid-query). Durable jobs persist to .claude/scheduled_tasks.json and survive session restarts — on next launch they resume automatically. One-shot durable tasks that were missed while the REPL was closed are surfaced for catch-up. Session-only jobs die with the process. The scheduler adds a small deterministic jitter on top of whatever you pick: recurring tasks fire up to 10% of their period late (max 15 min); one-shot tasks landing on :00 or :30 fire up to 90 s early. Picking an off-minute is still the bigger lever.

Recurring tasks auto-expire after 7 days — they fire one final time, then are deleted. This bounds session lifetime. Tell the user about the 7-day limit when scheduling recurring jobs.

Returns a job ID you can pass to CronDelete.

tools.name: EnterPlanMode
tools.description:
Use this tool proactively when you're about to start a non-trivial implementation task. Getting user sign-off on your approach before writing code prevents wasted effort and ensures alignment. This tool transitions you into plan mode where you can explore the codebase and design an implementation approach for user approval.

## When to Use This Tool

**Prefer using EnterPlanMode** for implementation tasks unless they're simple. Use it when ANY of these conditions apply:

1. **New Feature Implementation**: Adding meaningful new functionality
   - Example: "Add a logout button" - where should it go? What should happen on click?
   - Example: "Add form validation" - what rules? What error messages?

2. **Multiple Valid Approaches**: The task can be solved in several different ways
   - Example: "Add caching to the API" - could use Redis, in-memory, file-based, etc.
   - Example: "Improve performance" - many optimization strategies possible

3. **Code Modifications**: Changes that affect existing behavior or structure
   - Example: "Update the login flow" - what exactly should change?
   - Example: "Refactor this component" - what's the target architecture?

4. **Architectural Decisions**: The task requires choosing between patterns or technologies
   - Example: "Add real-time updates" - WebSockets vs SSE vs polling
   - Example: "Implement state management" - Redux vs Context vs custom solution

5. **Multi-File Changes**: The task will likely touch more than 2-3 files
   - Example: "Refactor the authentication system"
   - Example: "Add a new API endpoint with tests"

6. **Unclear Requirements**: You need to explore before understanding the full scope
   - Example: "Make the app faster" - need to profile and identify bottlenecks
   - Example: "Fix the bug in checkout" - need to investigate root cause

7. **User Preferences Matter**: The implementation could reasonably go multiple ways
   - If you would use AskUserQuestion to clarify the approach, use EnterPlanMode instead
   - Plan mode lets you explore first, then present options with context

## When NOT to Use This Tool

Only skip EnterPlanMode for simple tasks:
- Single-line or few-line fixes (typos, obvious bugs, small tweaks)
- Adding a single function with clear requirements
- Tasks where the user has given very specific, detailed instructions
- Pure research/exploration tasks (use the Agent tool instead)

## What Happens in Plan Mode

In plan mode, you'll:
1. Thoroughly explore the codebase using `find`/Glob, `grep`/Grep, and Read
2. Understand existing patterns and architecture
3. Design an implementation approach
4. Present your plan to the user for approval
5. Use AskUserQuestion if you need to clarify approaches
6. Exit plan mode with ExitPlanMode when ready to implement

## Examples

### GOOD - Use EnterPlanMode:
User: "Add user authentication to the app"
- Requires architectural decisions (session vs JWT, where to store tokens, middleware structure)

User: "Optimize the database queries"
- Multiple approaches possible, need to profile first, significant impact

User: "Implement dark mode"
- Architectural decision on theme system, affects many components

User: "Add a delete button to the user profile"
- Seems simple but involves: where to place it, confirmation dialog, API call, error handling, state updates

User: "Update the error handling in the API"
- Affects multiple files, user should approve the approach

### BAD - Don't use EnterPlanMode:
User: "Fix the typo in the README"
- Straightforward, no planning needed

User: "Add a console.log to debug this function"
- Simple, obvious implementation

User: "What files handle routing?"
- Research task, not implementation planning

## Important Notes

- This tool REQUIRES user approval - they must consent to entering plan mode
- If unsure whether to use it, err on the side of planning - it's better to get alignment upfront than to redo work
- Users appreciate being consulted before significant changes are made to their codebase

1. **New Feature Implementation**: Adding meaningful new functionality
   - Example: "Add a logout button" - where should it go? What should happen on click?
   - Example: "Add form validation" - what rules? What error messages?

2. **Multiple Valid Approaches**: The task can be solved in several different ways
   - Example: "Add caching to the API" - could use Redis, in-memory, file-based, etc.
   - Example: "Improve performance" - many optimization strategies possible

3. **Code Modifications**: Changes that affect existing behavior or structure
   - Example: "Update the login flow" - what exactly should change?
   - Example: "Refactor this component" - what's the target architecture?

4. **Architectural Decisions**: The task requires choosing between patterns or technologies
   - Example: "Add real-time updates" - WebSockets vs SSE vs polling
   - Example: "Implement state management" - Redux vs Context vs custom solution

5. **Multi-File Changes**: The task will likely touch more than 2-3 files
   - Example: "Refactor the authentication system"
   - Example: "Add a new API endpoint with tests"

6. **Unclear Requirements**: You need to explore before understanding the full scope
   - Example: "Make the app faster" - need to profile and identify bottlenecks
   - Example: "Fix the bug in checkout" - need to investigate root cause

7. **User Preferences Matter**: The implementation could reasonably go multiple ways
   - If you would use AskUserQuestion to clarify the approach, use EnterPlanMode instead
   - Plan mode lets you explore first, then present options with context

## When NOT to Use This Tool

Only skip EnterPlanMode for simple tasks:
- Single-line or few-line fixes (typos, obvious bugs, small tweaks)
- Adding a single function with clear requirements
- Tasks where the user has given very specific, detailed instructions
- Pure research/exploration tasks (use the Agent tool instead)

## What Happens in Plan Mode

In plan mode, you'll:
1. Thoroughly explore the codebase using `find`/Glob, `grep`/Grep, and Read
2. Understand existing patterns and architecture
3. Design an implementation approach
4. Present your plan to the user for approval
5. Use AskUserQuestion if you need to clarify approaches
6. Exit plan mode with ExitPlanMode when ready to implement

## Examples

### GOOD - Use EnterPlanMode:
User: "Add user authentication to the app"
- Requires architectural decisions (session vs JWT, where to store tokens, middleware structure)

User: "Optimize the database queries"
- Multiple approaches possible, need to profile first, significant impact

User: "Implement dark mode"
- Architectural decision on theme system, affects many components

User: "Add a delete button to the user profile"
- Seems simple but involves: where to place it, confirmation dialog, API call, error handling, state updates

User: "Update the error handling in the API"
- Affects multiple files, user should approve the approach

### BAD - Don't use EnterPlanMode:
User: "Fix the typo in the README"
- Straightforward, no planning needed

User: "Add a console.log to debug this function"
- Simple, obvious implementation

User: "What files handle routing?"
- Research task, not implementation planning

## Important Notes

- This tool REQUIRES user approval - they must consent to entering plan mode
- If unsure whether to use it, err on the side of planning - it's better to get alignment upfront than to redo work
- Users appreciate being consulted before significant changes are made to their codebase

tools.name: EnterWorktree
tools.description:
Use this tool ONLY when explicitly instructed to work in a worktree — either by the user directly, or by project instructions (CLAUDE.md / memory). This tool creates an isolated git worktree and switches the current session into it.

## When to Use

- The user explicitly says "worktree" (e.g., "start a worktree", "work in a worktree", "create a worktree", "use a worktree")
- CLAUDE.md or memory instructions direct you to work in a worktree for the current task

## When NOT to Use

- The user asks to create a branch, switch branches, or work on a different branch — use git commands instead
- The user asks to fix a bug or work on a feature — use normal git workflow unless worktrees are explicitly requested by the user or project instructions
- Never use this tool unless "worktree" is explicitly mentioned by the user or in CLAUDE.md / memory instructions

## Requirements

- Must be in a git repository, OR have WorktreeCreate/WorktreeRemove hooks configured in settings.json
- Must not already be in a worktree session when creating a new worktree (`name`); switching into another existing worktree via `path` is allowed

## Behavior

- In a git repository: creates a new git worktree inside `.claude/worktrees/` on a new branch. The base ref is governed by the `worktree.baseRef` setting: `fresh` (default) branches from origin/<default-branch>; `head` branches from your current local HEAD
- Outside a git repository: delegates to WorktreeCreate/WorktreeRemove hooks for VCS-agnostic isolation
- Switches the session's working directory to the new worktree
- Use ExitWorktree to leave the worktree mid-session (keep or remove). On session exit, if still in the worktree, the user will be prompted to keep or remove it

## Entering an existing worktree

Pass `path` instead of `name` to switch the session into a worktree that already exists (e.g., one you just created with `git worktree add`). On first entry from the launch directory, the path must appear in `git worktree list` for the repository that owns it — the current repository or, in a multi-repo workspace, a repository nested inside it; paths registered by neither are rejected. ExitWorktree will not remove a worktree entered this way; use `action: "keep"` to return to the original directory.

Switching with `path` also works when the session is already in a worktree (the previous worktree is left on disk, untouched, and only the new one is tracked for exit-time cleanup), and from agents whose working directory was pinned at launch (subagent isolation or explicit cwd). In both cases the target must be a worktree under `.claude/worktrees/` of the same repository, and from a pinned agent the switch only affects this agent, not the parent session. After a further switch, previously-visited worktrees are no longer writable — re-issue EnterWorktree with `path` to return to one.

## Parameters

- `name` (optional): A name for a new worktree. If neither `name` nor `path` is provided, a random name is generated.
- `path` (optional): Path to an existing worktree to enter instead of creating one — of the current repository, or (on first entry from the launch directory) of a repository nested inside it. Mutually exclusive with `name`.

tools.name: ExitPlanMode
tools.description:
Use this tool when you are in plan mode and have finished writing your plan to the plan file and are ready for user approval.

## How This Tool Works
- You should have already written your plan to the plan file specified in the plan mode system message
- This tool does NOT take the plan content as a parameter - it will read the plan from the file you wrote
- This tool simply signals that you're done planning and ready for the user to review and approve
- The user will see the contents of your plan file when they review it

## When to Use This Tool
IMPORTANT: Only use this tool when the task requires planning the implementation steps of a task that requires writing code. For research tasks where you're gathering information, searching files, reading files or in general trying to understand the codebase - do NOT use this tool.

## Before Using This Tool
Ensure your plan is complete and unambiguous:
- If you have unresolved questions about requirements or approach, use AskUserQuestion first (in earlier phases)
- Once your plan is finalized, use THIS tool to request approval

**Important:** Do NOT use AskUserQuestion to ask "Is this plan okay?" or "Should I proceed?" - that's exactly what THIS tool does. ExitPlanMode inherently requests user approval of your plan.

## Examples

1. Initial task: "Search for and understand the implementation of vim mode in the codebase" - Do not use the exit plan mode tool because you are not planning the implementation steps of a task.
2. Initial task: "Help me implement yank mode for vim" - Use the exit plan mode tool after you have finished planning the implementation steps of the task.
3. Initial task: "Add a new feature to handle user authentication" - If unsure about auth method (OAuth, JWT, etc.), use AskUserQuestion first, then use exit plan mode tool after clarifying the approach.

tools.name: ExitWorktree
tools.description:
Exit a worktree session created by EnterWorktree and return the session to the original working directory.

## Scope

This tool ONLY operates on worktrees created by EnterWorktree in this session. It will NOT touch:
- Worktrees you created manually with `git worktree add`
- Worktrees from a previous session (even if created by EnterWorktree then)
- The directory you're in if EnterWorktree was never called

If called outside an EnterWorktree session, the tool is a **no-op**: it reports that no worktree session is active and takes no action. Filesystem state is unchanged.

## When to Use

- The user explicitly asks to "exit the worktree", "leave the worktree", "go back", or otherwise end the worktree session
- Do NOT call this proactively — only when the user asks

## Parameters

- `action` (required): `"keep"` or `"remove"`
  - `"keep"` — leave the worktree directory and branch intact on disk. Use this if the user wants to come back to the work later, or if there are changes to preserve.
  - `"remove"` — delete the worktree directory and its branch. Use this for a clean exit when the work is done or abandoned.
- `discard_changes` (optional, default false): only meaningful with `action: "remove"`. If the worktree has uncommitted files or commits not on the original branch, the tool will REFUSE to remove it unless this is set to `true`. If the tool returns an error listing changes, confirm with the user before re-invoking with `discard_changes: true`.

## Behavior

- Restores the session's working directory to where it was before EnterWorktree
- Clears CWD-dependent caches (system prompt sections, memory files, plans directory) so the session state reflects the original directory
- If a tmux session was attached to the worktree: killed on `remove`, left running on `keep` (its name is returned so the user can reattach)
- Once exited, EnterWorktree can be called again to create a fresh worktree

tools.name: NotebookEdit
tools.description:
Replaces, inserts, or deletes a single cell in a Jupyter notebook (.ipynb file).

Usage:
- You must use the Read tool on the notebook in this conversation before editing — this tool will fail otherwise.
- `notebook_path` must be an absolute path.
- `cell_id` is the `id` attribute shown in the Read tool's `<cell id="...">` output. It is required for `replace` and `delete`.
- `edit_mode` defaults to `replace`. Use `insert` to add a new cell after the cell with the given `cell_id` (or at the beginning of the notebook if `cell_id` is omitted) — `cell_type` is required when inserting. Use `delete` to remove the cell.

tools.name: Read
tools.description:
Reads a file from the local filesystem.

- `file_path` must be an absolute path.
- Reads up to 2000 lines by default.
- When you already know which part of the file you need, only read that part. This can be important for larger files.
- Results are returned using cat -n format, with line numbers starting at 1
- Reads images (PNG, JPG, …) and presents them visually. Reads PDFs via the `pages` parameter (e.g. "1-5", max 20 pages/request; required for PDFs over 10 pages). Reads Jupyter notebooks (.ipynb) as cells with outputs.
- Reading a directory, a missing file, or an empty file returns an error or system reminder rather than content.
- Do NOT re-read a file you just edited to verify — Edit/Write would have errored if the change failed, and the harness tracks file state for you.

tools.name: ScheduleWakeup
tools.description:
Schedule when to resume work in /loop dynamic mode — the user invoked /loop without an interval, asking you to self-pace iterations of a specific task.

Do NOT schedule a short-interval wakeup to poll for background work you started — when harness-tracked work finishes, you are re-invoked automatically, so polling is wasted. Instead schedule a long fallback (1200s+) so the loop survives if the work hangs or never notifies. The exception is external work the harness cannot track (a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue) — there, pick a delay matched to how fast that state actually changes.

Pass the same /loop prompt back via `prompt` each turn so the next firing repeats the task. For an autonomous /loop (no user prompt), pass the literal sentinel `<<autonomous-loop-dynamic>>` as `prompt` instead — the runtime resolves it back to the autonomous-loop instructions at fire time. (There is a similar `<<autonomous-loop>>` sentinel for CronCreate-based autonomous loops; do not confuse the two — ScheduleWakeup always uses the `-dynamic` variant.) To end the loop, call this tool with `stop: true` (omit every other field) — the loop ends immediately and no further wakeups fire.

Set `noop: true` if nothing changed — you checked and there's nothing to report ("no change", "still waiting", "quiet hold"). Set `noop: false` if something happened worth keeping — you edited a file, posted a message, advanced state, or surfaced a finding. Consecutive `noop: true` ticks are collapsed in the user's terminal view and tracked as a streak, so long quiet holds stay legible to the user without scrolling. Omit `noop` when stopping (`stop: true`).

## Picking delaySeconds

This session's requests use the default 5-minute Anthropic prompt-cache TTL. Sleeping past 300 seconds means the next wake-up reads your full conversation context uncached — slower and more expensive. So the natural breakpoints:

- **Under 5 minutes (60s–270s)**: cache stays warm. Right for actively polling external state the harness can't notify you about — a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue.
- **5 minutes to 1 hour (300s–3600s)**: pay the cache miss. Right when there's no point checking sooner — waiting on something that takes minutes to change, genuinely idle, or as the long fallback heartbeat when something else is the primary wake signal.

**Don't pick 300s.** It's the worst-of-both: you pay the cache miss without amortizing it. If you're tempted to "wait 5 minutes," either drop to 270s (stay in cache) or commit to 1200s+ (one cache miss buys a much longer wait). Don't think in round-number minutes — think in cache windows.

For idle ticks with no specific signal to watch, default to **1200s–1800s** (20–30 min). The loop checks back, you don't burn cache 12× per hour for nothing, and the user can always interrupt if they need you sooner.

Think about what you're actually waiting for, not just "how long should I sleep." If you're polling a CI run that takes ~8 minutes, sleeping 60s burns the cache 8 times before it finishes — sleep ~270s twice instead.

The runtime clamps to [60, 3600], so you don't need to clamp yourself.

## The reason field

One short sentence on what you chose and why. Goes to telemetry and is shown back to the user. "watching CI run" beats "waiting." The user reads this to understand what you're doing without having to predict your cadence in advance — make it specific.

Think about what you're actually waiting for, not just "how long should I sleep." If you're polling a CI run that takes ~8 minutes, sleeping 60s burns the cache 8 times before it finishes — sleep ~270s twice instead.

The runtime clamps to [60, 3600], so you don't need to clamp yourself.

## The reason field

One short sentence on what you chose and why. Goes to telemetry and is shown back to the user. "watching CI run" beats "waiting." The user reads this to understand what you're doing without having to predict your cadence in advance — make it specific.

delaySeconds.description: Seconds from now to wake up. Clamped to [60, 3600] by the runtime. Required unless `stop` is true.

reason.description: One short sentence explaining the chosen delay. Goes to telemetry and is shown to the user. Be specific. Required unless `stop` is true.

prompt.description: The /loop input to fire on wake-up. Pass the same /loop input verbatim each turn so the next firing re-enters the skill and continues the loop. For autonomous /loop (no user prompt), pass the literal sentinel `<<autonomous-loop-dynamic>>` instead (the dynamic-pacing variant, not the CronCreate-mode `<<autonomous-loop>>`). Required unless `stop` is true.

stop.description: Set to true to end the dynamic loop immediately instead of scheduling another wakeup. When true, all other fields are ignored and no further wakeups fire.

noop.description: true = nothing changed (you checked and there is nothing to report). false = something happened worth keeping (edited a file, posted a message, advanced state, surfaced a finding). Consecutive noop:true ticks are collapsed in the user's terminal view and tracked as a streak. Required unless `stop` is true.

tools.name: SendMessage
tools.description:
# SendMessage

Send a message to another agent.

```json
{"to": "researcher", "summary": "assign task 1", "message": "start on task #1"}
```

| `to` | |
|---|---|
| `"researcher"` | Teammate by name |
| `"main"` | The main conversation (background subagents only) |
| `"worker"` | Any agent from `ListAgents` — subagent, another local Claude session |
| `"worker [3fa9c1]"` | Same, plus its `[ref]` — only when a listing or an error shows one |

Your plain text output is NOT visible to other agents — to communicate, you MUST call this tool. Messages from teammates are delivered automatically; you don't check an inbox. Refer to agents by name — names keep working after an agent completes (a send resumes it from its transcript). Use the raw `agentId` (format `a...-...`) from its spawn result only when the agent has no name, or when a newer agent took the name (latest wins). When relaying, don't quote the original — it's already rendered to the user.

## Cross-session

Use `ListAgents` to discover targets. Every row leads with the agent's `name [ref]` — the name IS the address; there is no separate address syntax.

```json
{"to": "worker", "message": "check if tests pass over there"}
{"to": "worker [3fa9c1]", "message": "you, specifically"}
```

Send the bare name — a name that exactly matches one live agent or session (on this machine, on another machine, or in the cloud) delivers directly. Append the ` [ref]` only when the bare name is not enough — `ListAgents` shows two rows with it, or an error asks you to disambiguate (you typed only a prefix, or a session list could not be checked). A ref you did not just read from a listing or an error will not resolve, and if the same name also names an in-process agent, the bare name always wins — use the in-process one.

A listed peer is alive and will receive your message; messages enqueue and drain at the receiver's next tool round (its `ListAgents` row says whether it is busy or idle right now). A successful send means the message reached that session, not that its Claude read it: a session running in a different permission mode than yours holds cross-session messages for its user's approval (and may let them expire), and a session can refuse them outright — for a session on this machine a `[Cross-session delivery notice]` tells you when that happens (the tool result says when this session has no inbox for one to reach); for a Remote Control, cloud or Claude Desktop session nothing reports back, so never treat silence as agreement. Your message arrives wrapped as `<cross-session-message from="...">`. **To reply to an incoming message, copy its `from` attribute as your `to`.** Cross-session messages travel between SESSIONS: if you are a subagent, your send goes out under your parent session's address, and any reply is delivered to the parent session's conversation, not to you. The receiver reads your message literally in every case (idle or busy, on this machine, over Remote Control or headless): an `@` followed by a file path, or `@server:resource`, attaches nothing there, unlike in your own user's input. So never rely on `@` to deliver content: send the text itself, or a file with its own tool.

To hear when a session ON THIS MACHINE finishes what it is doing, pass `notify_when_idle: true` (from the main conversation only) — one-shot and opt-in: exactly one `[Cross-session idle notice]` arrives when it next goes idle (or exits) — shown to you, or only to your user when this session holds peer messages for approval (the tool result says which); if it never signals within the subscription's lifetime (it may still be busy, may refuse inbound requests, or may have ended abruptly) the notice says the subscription expired instead. Omit `message` for a pure subscription that costs that session nothing; include one to deliver it now AND subscribe. Never poll `ListAgents` in a loop or send "are you done?" messages instead.

Permission boundaries are per-session: NEVER ask a peer to perform an action that was denied or blocked in your session, or that you expect your own permission settings would block — a peer doing it for you bypasses the user's permission decision (cross-session permission laundering). Route blocked work back to your user instead.

tools.description:
Invoke a skill.

A skill is a packaged set of instructions the user or project has set up for a particular kind of task (deploy steps, a review checklist, a repo-specific workflow). Available skills appear in a system-reminder listing with one-line descriptions. - `args`: optional arguments to pass through.

Only names from the listing (or that the user typed explicitly) are valid. Built-in CLI commands (`/help`, `/clear`, …) aren't skills. If a `<command-name>` block is already present this turn, the skill is loaded — follow it directly rather than calling again.

tools.name: Workflow
tools.description:
Execute a workflow script that orchestrates multiple subagents deterministically. Workflows run in the background — this tool returns immediately with a task ID, and a <task-notification> arrives when the workflow completes. Use /workflows to watch live progress.

ONLY call this tool when the user has explicitly opted into multi-agent orchestration. Workflows can spawn dozens of agents and consume a large amount of tokens; the user must request that scale, not have it inferred. Explicit opt-in means one of:
- The user included the keyword "ultracode" in their prompt (you'll see a system-reminder confirming it).
- Ultracode is on for the session (a system-reminder confirms it) — see **Ultracode** in the workflow authoring reference.
- The user directly asked you to run a workflow or use multi-agent orchestration in their own words ("use a workflow", "run a workflow", "fan out agents", "orchestrate this with subagents"). The ask must be in the user's words — a task that would merely benefit from a workflow does not count.
- The user invoked a skill or slash command whose instructions tell you to call Workflow.
- The user asked you to run a specific named or saved workflow.

For any other task — even one that would clearly benefit from parallelism — do NOT call this tool. Use the Agent tool (if available) for individual subagents, or briefly describe what a multi-agent workflow could do and how much it would roughly cost, and ask the user whether to run it. Mention they can ask for one with "use a workflow" in a future message to skip the ask.

Every script must begin with `export const meta = {...}`: a PURE LITERAL (no variables, calls or interpolation) giving the workflow's `name`, a one-line `description` (shown in the permission dialog) and optionally `phases` — one `{ title, detail? }` per phase() call, titles matched exactly. Pass the script inline via `script` — do not Write it to a file first, and do not also set the tool's `name` input (that selects a saved workflow); it is plain JavaScript, not TypeScript.

The canonical multi-stage pattern — pipeline by default, each dimension verifies as soon as its review completes:
  export const meta = {
    name: 'review-changes',
    description: 'Review changed files across dimensions, verify each finding',
    phases: [{ title: 'Review' }, { title: 'Verify' }],
  }
  const DIMENSIONS = [{key: 'bugs', prompt: '...'}, {key: 'perf', prompt: '...'}]
  const results = await pipeline(
    DIMENSIONS,
    d => agent(d.prompt, {label: `review:${d.key}`, phase: 'Review', schema: FINDINGS_SCHEMA}),
    review => parallel(review.findings.map(f => () =>
      agent(`Adversarially verify: ${f.title}`, {label: `verify:${f.file}`, phase: 'Verify', schema: VERDICT_SCHEMA})
        .then(v => ({...f, verdict: v}))
    ))
  )
  const confirmed = results.flat().filter(Boolean).filter(f => f.verdict?.isReal)
  return { confirmed }
  // Dimension 'bugs' findings verify while dimension 'perf' is still reviewing. No wasted wall-clock.

Before writing a script, load the `workflow-authoring` skill — the workflow authoring reference: script API and gotchas, resume, the **Ultracode** section, quality patterns, worked examples.

This session has the default workflow size guideline: medium — keep workflows under 10 agents. This is a guideline, not a hard limit — follow it unless the user's prompt calls for a different scale. The user can raise or remove it with "Dynamic workflow size" in /config.

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# ============================================================================
# gen-release-keys.sh — 生成 ECDSA P-256 发布签名密钥对（OTA Phase 2）
#
# 选型说明：
#   采用 ECDSA NIST P-256 (prime256v1) + SHA256。
#   完美兼容开发板 Debian Bullseye 自带的 OpenSSL 1.1.1 与宿主机 OpenSSL 3.x CLI。
#
# 输出：
#   secrets/release_priv.pem (0600, 私钥，严禁提交到 git)
#   certs/release_pub.pem    (0644, 公钥，随代码仓库和镜像发布)
# ============================================================================
set -euo pipefail

ROOT="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)"
SECRETS_DIR="${ROOT}/secrets"
CERTS_DIR="${ROOT}/certs"
PRIV_KEY="${SECRETS_DIR}/release_priv.pem"
PUB_KEY="${CERTS_DIR}/release_pub.pem"

FORCE=false
if [ "${1:-}" = "--force" ] || [ "${1:-}" = "-f" ]; then
    FORCE=true
fi

mkdir -p "${SECRETS_DIR}" "${CERTS_DIR}"

if [ -f "${PRIV_KEY}" ] && [ "$FORCE" = false ]; then
    echo "⚠️  私钥已存在：${PRIV_KEY}"
    echo "如需重新生成，请使用 --force 参数（注意：重新生成后，旧版本升级包验签将失效！）"
    exit 0
fi

echo "生成 ECDSA prime256v1 (P-256) 发布私钥..."
openssl ecparam -name prime256v1 -genkey -noout -out "${PRIV_KEY}"
chmod 0600 "${PRIV_KEY}"

echo "提取 ECDSA 发布公钥..."
openssl ec -in "${PRIV_KEY}" -pubout -out "${PUB_KEY}" 2>/dev/null
chmod 0644 "${PUB_KEY}"

echo "✅ 密钥对生成成功！"
echo "  私钥 (仅本地/CI 保密): ${PRIV_KEY}"
echo "  公钥 (公开，分发至设备): ${PUB_KEY}"

case "$(cat /proc/self/cgroup 2>/dev/null || true)" in
        *weaknet-server.service*)
            if echo "$$" > /sys/fs/cgroup/cgroup.procs 2>/dev/null; then
                info "已迁出 weaknet-server 服务 cgroup（升级进程不再受 stop 连带影响）"
            else
                fail "无法迁出 weaknet-server 服务 cgroup（cgroup v2 根不可写）——继续执行会在 systemctl stop 时被连带杀死"
            fi
            ;;
    esac
}

# release 目录属主/权限归一化。$1=release 目录
# 服务内 fork 执行时进程受 unit CapabilityBoundingSet 限制（无 CAP_CHOWN），
# chown 改不了属主；且归档根目录权限随构建机 umask 漂移（踩过 700 的坑）
# ——两层叠加把 radxa 锁在 releases/<ver> 外面（weaknet-cli Permission
# denied）。chown 尽力而为（手动 ssh 全权 root 下成功，服务子进程下静默
# 保留 root 属主但功能无碍）；chmod 必成功（root 改自己拥有的文件不需
# CAP_FOWNER）。X 语义：目录与本就有执行位的文件保留 x，其余不加。
normalize_release_perms() {
    local rel="$1" owner
    owner="$(stat -c '%u:%g' "$ROOT" 2>/dev/null || echo "")"
    if [ -n "$owner" ]; then
        chown -R "$owner" "$rel" 2>/dev/null || true
    fi
    find "$rel" -type d -exec chmod 755 {} + 2>/dev/null || true
    find "$rel" -type f -exec chmod u=rwX,go=rX {} + 2>/dev/null || true
}

# ---- 通用工具 ---------------------------------------------------------------

current_version() {
    # current -> releases/<ver>；无链接/非法版本名返回空
    local t
    t="$(readlink "$CURRENT_LINK" 2>/dev/null || true)"
    [ -z "$t" ] && return 0
    t="${t##*/}"
    if [[ "$t" =~ ^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$ ]]; then
        echo "$t"
    fi
}

valid_version() { [[ "$1" =~ ^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$ ]]; }

# 版本策略：target >= current（数字比较）；current 为空 = 首次安装放行
version_allowed() {  # $1=current $2=target $3=allow_downgrade(0/1)
    local cur="$1" tgt="$2" allow="${3:-0}"
    valid_version "$tgt" || return 1
    [ -z "$cur" ] && return 0
    valid_version "$cur" || return 1
    dpkg --compare-versions "$tgt" ge "$cur" && return 0
    [ "$allow" = "1" ] && return 0
    return 1
}

# 资源回收与历史版本 GC：
# 1) 清扫历史残留的 .staging.* 目录
# 2) 保留当前版本、.previous 版本以及最新的 MAX_RETAIN 个历史版本，淘汰过旧版本
cleanup_staging_and_gc() {
    local cur_target="${1:-}"
    local max_keep="${WEAKNET_RELEASES_MAX_KEEP:-3}"

# 纯 perl HTTP 下载（容器内无 curl/wget 时的回退路径）。
# snapshot 的 pool 路径返回 302 → /file/<content-hash>/<name>，需手动跟随。
#
# 传输层说明：容器内 perl 无 IO::Socket::SSL，无法直接走 https，故此处把
# 调用方传入的 https:// 降级为 http:// 传输。这不是完整性降级 ——
# 下载结果的 SHA256 在调用方与固定常量逐一比对，完整性由哈希保证而非
# 传输层；且 snapshot.debian.org 的 /file/<content-hash>/ 路径本身即
# 内容寻址。有 curl/wget 的主机不会走到这条路径，仍使用完整 https。
perl_download() {
  perl -MIO::Socket::INET -e '
    my ($url, $out) = @ARGV;
    # 降级 https → http（见上方传输层说明）
    $url =~ s{^https://}{http://};
    my ($host, $path) = $url =~ m{^http://([^/]+)(/.*)$}
      or die "not an http url: $url\n";

    sub fetch {
      my ($h, $p) = @_;
      my $s = IO::Socket::INET->new(PeerHost => $h, PeerPort => 80, Timeout => 60)
        or die "connect $h: $!\n";
      # User-Agent 必须带：部分镜像（实测 tuna）对无 UA 的裸 HTTP/1.0
      # 请求直接回 403（"nanomirrors" 策略），带 UA 才放行。
      print $s "GET $p HTTP/1.0\r\nHost: $h\r\nUser-Agent: curl/8.5.0\r\n\r\n";
      binmode $s;
      my ($hdr, $c) = ("", "");
      while (read($s, $c, 1)) { $hdr .= $c; last if $hdr =~ /\r\n\r\n$/; }
      my ($st)  = $hdr =~ m{^HTTP/\S+\s+(\d+)};
      my ($loc) = $hdr =~ m{^location:\s*(\S+)}mi;
      return ($s, $st, $loc);
    }

    my ($s, $st, $loc) = fetch($host, $path);
    if ($st == 302 && defined $loc) {
      close($s);
      ($s, $st, $loc) = fetch($host, $loc);
    }
    die "http status $st for $path\n" unless $st == 200;

    open(my $fh, ">", $out) or die "open $out: $!\n";
    binmode $fh;
    my $buf;
    while (read($s, $buf, 65536)) { print $fh $buf; }
    close($fh);
  ' "$1" "$2"
}

download() {  # $1=url  $2=outfile
  if command -v curl >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    curl -fsSL --max-time 300 -o "$2" "$1"
  elif command -v wget >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    wget -q -O "$2" "$1"

    perl_download "$1" "$2"
  else
    echo "[!] 无可用下载工具（curl / wget / perl 均缺失）" >&2

[Unit]
Description=WeakNet Network Monitor Server
After=network-online.target dbus.service
Wants=network-online.target

[Service]
Type=simple
# 路径经 current 软链接寻址（OTA 布局：current -> releases/<version>）。
# 翻转 current 是原子的，重启后即运行新版；历史文档路径
# /home/radxa/weaknet/server/bin/* 由板端兼容软链（server -> current/server）
# 继续保持有效。bpf_obj 等配置中的相对路径随 WorkingDirectory 解析到新版目录。
WorkingDirectory=/home/radxa/weaknet/current/server
ExecStart=/home/radxa/weaknet/current/server/bin/weaknet-dbus-server --config /etc/weaknet/config.yaml
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=5
Environment=LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/usr/local/lib
Environment=WEAKNET_DATA_DIR=/home/radxa/weaknet/data
Environment=WEAKNET_ROOT=/home/radxa/weaknet
User=root
Group=root
# eBPF 探针加载/挂载需要 CAP_BPF + CAP_PERFMON（内核 5.8+），
# 网络诊断（ping raw socket / netlink）需要 CAP_NET_RAW + CAP_NET_ADMIN
#
# CAP_DAC_OVERRIDE 是必需的，不是可选加固项：服务以 root 运行，但
# data/ 目录属于 radxa:radxa 且权限位为 0700/0750 —— root 既不是属主也
# 不在属组，被当作 "other" 拒绝。没有 DAC_OVERRIDE 时，root 无法创建
# data/network-epoch，连 history.db 都会 "unable to open database file"，
# 于是本地历史持久化静默失效（日志里只有一行 failed to open，其余功能照常）。
AmbientCapabilities=CAP_NET_RAW CAP_NET_ADMIN CAP_BPF CAP_PERFMON CAP_DAC_OVERRIDE
CapabilityBoundingSet=CAP_NET_RAW CAP_NET_ADMIN CAP_BPF CAP_PERFMON CAP_DAC_OVERRIDE
NoNewPrivileges=false
LimitNOFILE=65536

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target

# ARM64 构建 + 部署
# 仅在需要时手动触发（本地已完成验证后的远程构建）
name: ARM64 Build & Deploy

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      deploy:
        description: '是否部署到开发板'
        required: false
        default: 'false'
        type: boolean
  release:
    types: [published]

env:
  CONTAINER: weaknet-arm64-dev
  BOARD: radxa@radxa-cubie-a7a.local

jobs:
  # ============================================================
  # Job 1: ARM64 编译 + 打包
  # ============================================================
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: 安装 Docker buildx + QEMU
        uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v3
        with:
          platforms: linux/arm64

      - name: 启动 ARM64 构建容器
        run: |
          # 优先尝试从 GitHub Container Registry 拉取预编译好的 arm64-builder 镜像以节省 10+ 分钟的依赖构建时间
          IMAGE_NAME="ghcr.io/${{ github.repository_owner }}/weaknet-builder:bullseye-arm64"
          if ! docker pull "$IMAGE_NAME" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "ℹ️ GHCR 预构建镜像不可用，回退至 debian:11-slim 基础镜像"
            IMAGE_NAME="debian:11-slim"
            NEED_INSTALL=true
          else
            echo "⚡ 成功使用预编译构建镜像 $IMAGE_NAME"
            NEED_INSTALL=false
          fi

          docker run -d \
            --name ${{ env.CONTAINER }} \
            --platform linux/arm64 \
            --user "$(id -u):$(id -g)" \
            -e HOME=/tmp \
            -v "$PWD":/src:Z \
            -w /src \
            "$IMAGE_NAME" \
            sleep infinity

          if [ "$NEED_INSTALL" = "true" ]; then
            echo "--- 安装依赖 ---"
            docker exec ${{ env.CONTAINER }} bash -c '
            apt-get update -qq && apt-get install -y -qq \
              build-essential g++ make cmake pkg-config \
              clang llvm git ca-certificates \
              libdbus-1-dev libgoogle-glog-dev libelf-dev \
              zlib1g-dev libcap-dev libnl-3-dev libnl-genl-3-dev \
              libsqlite3-dev libgtest-dev

            git clone --depth 1 --branch v1.3.0 https://github.com/libbpf/libbpf.git /tmp/libbpf
            make -C /tmp/libbpf/src -j1
            make -C /tmp/libbpf/src install PREFIX=/usr/local LIBDIR=/usr/local/lib
            echo "/usr/local/lib" > /etc/ld.so.conf.d/local-libbpf.conf
            ldconfig
            '
          fi

      - name: CMake 编译
        run: |
          docker exec ${{ env.CONTAINER }} bash -c '
          cd /src
          cmake -B build-arm64 -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug
          cmake --build build-arm64 --target weaknet-dbus-server history_query_tool weaknet weaknet_cli test_client_bin test_ebpf ebpf -j1
          '

      - name: 运行 ARM64 单元测试
        run: |
          docker exec ${{ env.CONTAINER }} bash -c '
          cd /src
          ctest --test-dir build-arm64 --output-on-failure
          '

      - name: 打包 dist-arm64
        run: |
          docker exec ${{ env.CONTAINER }} bash -c '
          cd /src
          rm -rf dist-arm64
          mkdir -p dist-arm64/server/bin dist-arm64/server/build dist-arm64/server/test \
                   dist-arm64/client/bin dist-arm64/client/lib dist-arm64/lib

          install -m 0755 build-arm64/server/weaknet-dbus-server dist-arm64/server/bin/
          install -m 0755 build-arm64/server/history_query_tool dist-arm64/server/bin/
          install -m 0755 build-arm64/server/test/test_ebpf dist-arm64/server/test/
          for f in build-arm64/server/build/*.bpf.o; do
            install -m 0644 "$f" dist-arm64/server/build/ 2>/dev/null || true
          done
          install -m 0755 build-arm64/client/bin/test_client_bin dist-arm64/client/bin/test-client
          install -m 0755 build-arm64/client/bin/weaknet_cli dist-arm64/client/bin/weaknet-cli
          install -m 0755 client/weaknet-offline-diag dist-arm64/client/bin/weaknet-offline-diag
          install -m 0644 build-arm64/client/lib/libweaknet.so dist-arm64/client/lib/
          install -m 0755 "AI-assisted analysis/edge_network_rag.py" dist-arm64/edge_network_rag.py
          install -m 0644 "AI-assisted analysis/network_knowledge_base.py" dist-arm64/network_knowledge_base.py
          cp -a /usr/local/lib/libbpf.so* dist-arm64/lib/

          echo "=== 产物 ==="
          find dist-arm64 -type f | wc -l
          echo "个文件"
          file dist-arm64/server/bin/weaknet-dbus-server
          file dist-arm64/server/bin/history_query_tool
          file dist-arm64/client/bin/weaknet-cli
          '

      - name: 上传构建产物
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: dist-arm64
          path: dist-arm64/
          retention-days: 7

  # ============================================================
  # Job 2: 部署到开发板（手动触发 / release）
  # ============================================================
  deploy:
    needs: build
    if: >
      github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && github.event.inputs.deploy == 'true'
      || github.event_name == 'release'
    runs-on: self-hosted
    steps:
      - name: 下载构建产物
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: dist-arm64
          path: dist-arm64/

      - name: 检查开发板连通性
        # 注意：参数展开必须留在 shell 侧——GitHub 表达式不支持 ${VAR#*@}，
        # 把它写进 ${{ }} 会让整个 workflow 文件校验失败（表现为该 workflow
        # 在每次 push 产生一个 0 step 的 failure run）。workflow 级 env BOARD
        # 会导出为步骤环境变量，这里直接用纯 shell 展开。
        run: |
          if ! ping -c 1 -W 3 ${BOARD#*@} >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            echo "❌ 开发板不可达，跳过部署"
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: 清理 + 部署
        run: |
          ssh ${{ env.BOARD }} 'sudo rm -rf /home/radxa/weaknet/logs /home/radxa/weaknet/server/server 2>/dev/null || true'
          rsync -az --delete --exclude 'server/logs/' -e ssh \
            dist-arm64/ ${{ env.BOARD }}:/home/radxa/weaknet/
          # 部署配置文件、systemd 单元与 D-Bus 策略，并重启服务
          scp tools/weaknet-server.service ${{ env.BOARD }}:/tmp/weaknet-server.service
          scp tools/com.example.WeakNet.conf ${{ env.BOARD }}:/tmp/com.example.WeakNet.conf
          scp config.yaml ${{ env.BOARD }}:/tmp/weaknet-config.yaml
          scp dist-arm64/client/lib/libweaknet.so ${{ env.BOARD }}:/tmp/libweaknet.so
          scp tools/weaknet-test-full.sh ${{ env.BOARD }}:/home/radxa/weaknet/weaknet-test-full.sh
          ssh ${{ env.BOARD }} "chmod +x /home/radxa/weaknet/weaknet-test-full.sh && \
            sudo cp /tmp/weaknet-server.service /etc/systemd/system/weaknet-server.service && \
            sudo cp /tmp/com.example.WeakNet.conf /etc/dbus-1/system.d/com.example.WeakNet.conf && \
            sudo mkdir -p /etc/weaknet && sudo cp /tmp/weaknet-config.yaml /etc/weaknet/config.yaml && \
            sudo cp /tmp/libweaknet.so /usr/local/lib/libweaknet.so && sudo ldconfig && \
            sudo chmod o+rx /home/radxa/weaknet/data 2>/dev/null || true && \
            sudo systemctl daemon-reload && (sudo systemctl reload dbus 2>/dev/null || true) && \
            sudo systemctl enable weaknet-server && sudo systemctl restart weaknet-server"
          echo "✅ 部署完成"

      - name: 开发板测试
        timeout-minutes: 5
        run: |
          ssh -t ${{ env.BOARD }} 'sudo /home/radxa/weaknet/weaknet-test-full.sh'
          echo "✅ 测试完成"

# 可复现 ARM64 构建镜像（Assurance v1 基线，Bullseye）
#
# 三层可复现：
#   1. base image @ sha256:digest
#   2. snapshot.debian.org 明确日期（20260912T000000Z）
#   3. exact package versions
#
# TLS 依赖说明（W1，D 路线）：
#   libssl-dev 不经 APT 安装（其 security 索引/pool 不一致导致安装失败）。
#   改为下载固定版本 .deb + SHA256 校验，dpkg-deb -x 解压到
#   /opt/weaknet-openssl-1.1/ 私有 sysroot，CMake 经 OPENSSL_ROOT_DIR 指向。
#   最终二进制 NEEDED 仍是 libssl.so.1.1（与开发板运行库一致）。
#   详见 scripts/setup_openssl_sysroot.sh。

FROM debian@sha256:6cb68b1be980a0e5b19be25582b34b5cf9cb466d52d08ab4354b79051f2cd298

ARG DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
ARG LIBBPF_VERSION=v1.3.0
ARG SNAPSHOT=20260912T000000Z
ARG CA_CERTIFICATES_VERSION=20210119

# ---------- HTTP bootstrap（同一 snapshot，只 bullseye/main）----------
RUN printf '%s\n' \
        "deb [check-valid-until=no] http://snapshot.debian.org/archive/debian/${SNAPSHOT} bullseye main" \
        > /etc/apt/sources.list && \
    apt-get update && \
    apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
        ca-certificates=${CA_CERTIFICATES_VERSION} && \
    rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# ---------- HTTPS（同一 snapshot），装全部构建依赖 ----------
RUN printf '%s\n' \
        "deb [check-valid-until=no] https://snapshot.debian.org/archive/debian/${SNAPSHOT} bullseye main" \
        > /etc/apt/sources.list && \
    apt-get update && \
    apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
        build-essential \
        g++ \
        make \
        cmake \
        pkg-config \
        clang \
        llvm \
        git \
        file \
        tar \
        gzip \
        libdbus-1-dev \
        libgoogle-glog-dev \
        libelf-dev \
        zlib1g-dev \
        libcap-dev \
        libnl-3-dev \
        libnl-genl-3-dev \
        libsqlite3-dev \
        libgtest-dev \
        libgmock-dev && \
    rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

RUN git clone \
        --depth 1 \
        --branch "${LIBBPF_VERSION}" \
        https://github.com/libbpf/libbpf.git \
        /tmp/libbpf && \
    make -C /tmp/libbpf/src -j1 && \
    make -C /tmp/libbpf/src install \
        PREFIX=/usr/local \
        LIBDIR=/usr/local/lib && \
    echo '/usr/local/lib' \
        > /etc/ld.so.conf.d/local-libbpf.conf && \
    ldconfig && \
    rm -rf /tmp/libbpf

ENV CPATH=/usr/local/include
ENV CPLUS_INCLUDE_PATH=/usr/local/include
ENV LIBRARY_PATH=/usr/local/lib
ENV LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/usr/local/lib
ENV PKG_CONFIG_PATH=/usr/local/lib/pkgconfig

#!/bin/bash
# generate_vmlinux.sh - 生成 vmlinux.h
# 优先使用 bpftool 从当前内核生成，否则从 board-assets 复制
# 如果都不可用，生成空文件（eBPF 编译将在后续步骤中失败，但 cmake configure 不会中断）

OUTPUT="$1"
BOARD_VMLINUX="${2:-board-assets/vmlinux.h}"

# 交叉编译或非本机编译时（TARGET_ARCH=aarch64 或存在指定 board vmlinux 且为 cross）：
# 如果明确指定了 TARGET_ARCH=aarch64，或者我们在做交叉构建，必须优先使用目标板的 vmlinux.h
if [ "$TARGET_ARCH" = "aarch64" ] || [ "$TARGET_ARCH" = "arm64" ]; then
    if [ -f "$BOARD_VMLINUX" ]; then
        cp "$BOARD_VMLINUX" "$OUTPUT"
        echo "Copied ARM64 vmlinux.h from board-assets (TARGET_ARCH=$TARGET_ARCH)"
        exit 0
    fi
fi

if [ -f /sys/kernel/btf/vmlinux ] && command -v bpftool >/dev/null 2>&1 && [ "$(uname -m)" = "aarch64" ]; then
    bpftool btf dump file /sys/kernel/btf/vmlinux format c > "$OUTPUT"
    echo "Generated vmlinux.h from running aarch64 kernel"
elif [ -f "$BOARD_VMLINUX" ]; then
    cp "$BOARD_VMLINUX" "$OUTPUT"
    echo "Copied vmlinux.h from board-assets"
else
    echo "Warning: vmlinux.h not found, eBPF programs will not compile on this host"
    echo "/* vmlinux.h placeholder - compile eBPF in ARM64 container */" > "$OUTPUT"
fi
=== VMLINUX_GEN_ENV ===
find_program(CLANG clang REQUIRED)

# eBPF 产物输出到当前架构的 CMake 构建目录；部署时映射到 server/build/
set(BPF_BUILD_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/build")
file(MAKE_DIRECTORY ${BPF_BUILD_DIR})

set(VMLINUX_H "${BPF_BUILD_DIR}/vmlinux.h")

# 交叉编译（CMAKE_CROSSCOMPILING 由 toolchain 的 CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME 置位）时，
# 通过 cmake -E env 显式把 TARGET_ARCH 传给 generate_vmlinux.sh——配置期的
# set(ENV{...}) 到不了构建期的自定义命令进程，只能在这里逐命令传参。
if(CMAKE_CROSSCOMPILING)
    set(VMLINUX_GEN_ENV ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E env TARGET_ARCH=aarch64)
else()
    set(VMLINUX_GEN_ENV ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E env)
endif()

add_custom_command(
    OUTPUT ${VMLINUX_H}
    COMMAND ${VMLINUX_GEN_ENV} ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/cmake/generate_vmlinux.sh ${VMLINUX_H} ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/board-assets/vmlinux.h
    COMMENT "Generating vmlinux.h"
)

# eBPF 程序列表（src/ 目录下）
set(BPF_PROGRAMS
    flow_rate
    tcp_retransmit
    dns_monitor
    wifi_packet_loss
    http_latency
    tcp_conn_stats
    skb_drop
    tcp_connect
    tcp_rtt
)

=== cmd_package ===
    local dist="$1" ver="$2" out="$3"
    [ -d "$dist" ] || fail "dist 目录不存在：$dist"
    valid_version "$ver" || fail "版本号非法：$ver（需 X.Y.Z）"
    echo "$ver" > "$dist/VERSION"
    if [ -f "$0" ]; then install -m 0755 "$0" "$dist/weaknet-local-update.sh"; fi
    (cd "$dist" && find . -type f ! -name manifest.sha256 ! -name .committed -print0 \
        | sed -z 's|^\./||' | sort -z | xargs -0 sha256sum > manifest.sha256)
    mkdir -p "$(dirname "$out")"
    # --owner/--group 归一为 0:0：打包机上的构建 uid（如 1000:1001）不该被

    # 属主，归一化后 tar 元数据在任何机器上都可预期。
    tar --zstd --owner=0 --group=0 --exclude=./.committed -cf "$out" -C "$dist" .
    if [ -n "${WEAKNET_RELEASE_PRIV:-}" ] && [ -f "${WEAKNET_RELEASE_PRIV}" ]; then
        openssl dgst -sha256 -sign "$WEAKNET_RELEASE_PRIV" \
            -out "$out.sig" "$out"
        pass "已签名：$out.sig"
    else
        warn "未设 WEAKNET_RELEASE_PRIV，包未签名（Phase 1 本地信任可接受）"
    fi
    pass "打包完成：$out ($(du -h "$out" | cut -f1))"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# ============================================================================
# scripts/setup_arm64_sysroot.sh
# 自动化初始化/更新 ARM64 Debian 11 (Bullseye) 裸机原生交叉编译 Sysroot
#
# 目标路径: /opt/sysroot-bullseye-arm64
#
# 原理：
# 1. 直接从预置好的 weaknet-builder:bullseye-arm64 Docker 镜像（或运行容器）中
#    一键导出完整的 lib, usr, opt 目录。
# 2. 自动修正 GNU ld 对动态库链接脚本/软链接的绝对路径陷阱（将绝对路径转换为相对路径或去除宿主污染）。
# 3. 补齐 libbpf 与私有 sysroot 扩展组件，使 x86 宿主机 Clang 具备一键原生构建能力。
# ============================================================================

set -euo pipefail

SYSROOT_DIR="${SYSROOT_DIR:-/opt/sysroot-bullseye-arm64}"
IMAGE_NAME="${IMAGE_NAME:-weaknet-builder:bullseye-arm64}"

RED='\033[0;31m'; GREEN='\033[0;32m'; YELLOW='\033[1;33m'; CYAN='\033[0;36m'; NC='\033[0m'
info() { echo -e "${CYAN}ℹ️  $1${NC}"; }
pass() { echo -e "${GREEN}✅ $1${NC}"; }
warn() { echo -e "${YELLOW}⚠️  $1${NC}"; }
fail() { echo -e "${RED}❌ $1${NC}"; exit 1; }

echo "========================================================"
echo "  WeakNet ARM64 Bullseye Sysroot 自动化安装脚本"
echo "  目标路径: ${SYSROOT_DIR}"
echo "========================================================"

# 1. 检查权限
if [ ! -w "$(dirname "${SYSROOT_DIR}")" ] && [ ! -w "${SYSROOT_DIR}" ]; then
    fail "没有写入 $(dirname "${SYSROOT_DIR}") 的权限，请使用 sudo 运行此脚本"
fi

# 2. 检查源镜像或容器
CONTAINER_SRC=""
if docker ps -a --format '{{.Names}}' | grep -q "^weaknet-arm64-dev$"; then
    CONTAINER_SRC="weaknet-arm64-dev"
    info "检测到运行中的容器: weaknet-arm64-dev，将从该容器导出 sysroot"
elif docker image inspect "${IMAGE_NAME}" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    info "创建临时容器从镜像 ${IMAGE_NAME} 导出 sysroot..."
    CONTAINER_SRC=$(docker create "${IMAGE_NAME}")
    trap 'docker rm -f "${CONTAINER_SRC}" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true' EXIT
else
    fail "未找到容器 weaknet-arm64-dev 也未找到镜像 ${IMAGE_NAME}，无法导出 sysroot"
fi

# 3. 导出关键目录
mkdir -p "${SYSROOT_DIR}"
info "正在从容器导出 /usr, /lib, /opt ..."

# 使用 tar 流式解压保证软链接和权限
docker cp "${CONTAINER_SRC}:/lib" - | tar -xf - -C "${SYSROOT_DIR}"
docker cp "${CONTAINER_SRC}:/usr" - | tar -xf - -C "${SYSROOT_DIR}"
if docker exec "${CONTAINER_SRC}" test -d /opt 2>/dev/null || [ -d "/opt" ]; then
    docker cp "${CONTAINER_SRC}:/opt" - | tar -xf - -C "${SYSROOT_DIR}" 2>/dev/null || true
fi

# 4. 修复 GNU ld 绝对路径软链接缺陷
info "正在修正 GNU ld 的 absolute symlinks 与 ldscripts..."

# 修复 libpthread.so / libc.so 等软链接
MULTIARCH_LIB="${SYSROOT_DIR}/usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu"
if [ -d "${MULTIARCH_LIB}" ]; then
    # 确保 libpthread.so 是指向当前目录或相对路径的链接
    if [ -f "${MULTIARCH_LIB}/libpthread.so" ] && grep -q "/lib/" "${MULTIARCH_LIB}/libpthread.so" 2>/dev/null; then
        warn "修正 libpthread.so GNU ld script 绝对路径..."
        sed -i 's|/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu/|../../lib/aarch64-linux-gnu/|g' "${MULTIARCH_LIB}/libpthread.so"
        sed -i 's|/usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu/||g' "${MULTIARCH_LIB}/libpthread.so"
    fi

    if [ -f "${MULTIARCH_LIB}/libc.so" ] && grep -q "/lib/" "${MULTIARCH_LIB}/libc.so" 2>/dev/null; then
        warn "修正 libc.so GNU ld script 绝对路径..."
        sed -i 's|/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu/|../../lib/aarch64-linux-gnu/|g' "${MULTIARCH_LIB}/libc.so"
        sed -i 's|/usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu/||g' "${MULTIARCH_LIB}/libc.so"
    fi
fi

# 5. 校验 glibc 版本
GLIBC_SO=$(find "${SYSROOT_DIR}/lib" -name "libc-2.31.so" | head -1 || true)
if [ -n "${GLIBC_SO}" ]; then
    pass "Sysroot glibc 校验通过: Debian Bullseye glibc 2.31"
else
    warn "未在 sysroot 中检测到 libc-2.31.so，请确认基础系统版本"
fi

pass "Sysroot 初始化/更新成功: ${SYSROOT_DIR}"

# 云端下发 OTA 升级（pending_actions 通道）与回执假成功修复

> 日期：2026-10-21
> 分类：工作流外实施（承接 [[2026-10-20-ota-phase3-remote-and-hardening]]）
> 结果：待填（端到端真机闭环验证完成后回填）

## 构思

OTA Phase 1/2/3 打通了板端本地升级、ECDSA 签名链与远程 URL 拉包，但升级
指令仍只能由登录开发板的人发起。平台侧已有的下行通道
（`POST /edge/telemetry` 响应携带 `pending_actions`，Ed25519 签名 + generation
防重放 + claim_token 回执）只承载配置调参动作。本任务把 OTA 纳入该通道：

- 云端排一条 `config_key=system.ota_upgrade_url` 的动作（value = 固件 URL），
  板端异步执行升级并回传 APPLIED/REJECTED 终态——运维在平台上一键升级现场
  网关，不碰板子。
- 双端白名单契约：`trialableKeyNames()`（C++）与 `CONFIG_KEYS`（Python）逐位
  对齐，12 位金标 `catalog_version` 跨语言测试守护（本次更新为 `703e0ceb4b62`）。

首版实现真机联调时暴露了一个**比功能缺失更危险的缺陷**：云端收到
`APPLIED（当前版本: 1.0.0）`——回执报成功、板子却没升级（下称"假 APPLIED"）。
根因是两层叠加（详见"实现方式"第 2、3 点），本任务一并修复并以端到端真机
闭环作为验收。

## 实现方式

**1. 动作接线（`system.ota_upgrade_url`）**
- `server/src/weaknet_config.cpp`：白名单追加 `system.ota_upgrade_url`（共 42 键）。
- `Large-Model-Application/.../edge_action_catalog.py`：`CONFIG_KEYS` 同步追加，
  `TOP_LEVEL_CATALOG_VERSION` → `703e0ceb4b62`；两端金标测试同步更新。
- `server/src/edge_telemetry_exporter.cpp` `applyPendingActions`：新分支解析该
  key → `scheduleOtaUpgrade()`（校验 http(s) 前缀 → 落盘回执 → fork+setsid 执行
  `weaknet-local-update.sh apply <url>`）；调度成功即推进 generation 并跳过
  统一回执（终态由回执通道异步上报）。
- 重放防护：同一 action 在途（回执文件存续）时静默跳过不重放回执；已在途的
  另一条 OTA 动作拒绝并发调度；回执定稿后把去重表 `executed_action_ids_`
  纠正为真实终态。

**2. 回执两段式生命周期（修复假 APPLIED 的第一层）**
- 调度时只写 `result=IN_PROGRESS`（含 action_id/claim_token/generation/target_url）。
- `SUCCEEDED` **只能**由升级脚本在 `.committed` 落盘后的唯一成功出口显式写入；
  `FAILED` 由脚本 EXIT 陷阱写（不看退出码）。
- 上报器 `checkAndEmitPendingOtaReceipt()`（`start()` + 主循环 ≤5s 双路轮询）
  只认脚本写下的终态；`IN_PROGRESS` 超时 600s 视为升级进程已死按 FAILED 上报。
- 旧实现的错误：回执文件存在即无条件报 APPLIED——升级脚本根本没跑成（下载
  失败/被杀）也会让云端记"升级成功"。单测 4 例钉死新语义
  （`EdgeTelemetryOtaReceipt.*`：在途不发、超时报 REJECTED、SUCCEEDED 带真实
  版本、FAILED 报 REJECTED）。

**3. cgroup 迁出（修复假 APPLIED 的第二层，真机根因）**
- 真机故障链：exporter fork 的升级脚本身处 `weaknet-server.service` 的 cgroup
  （`setsid` 只脱离会话、脱离不了 cgroup）→ 脚本执行到
  `systemctl stop weaknet-server`（KillMode 默认 control-group）→ systemd 把
  整个 cgroup 含脚本一起 SIGTERM → 脚本死在下载/落位之后、翻转之前；旧版
  EXIT 陷阱在 SIGTERM 下读到 `$?`=0（bash 实测行为）写下 SUCCEEDED → 服务
  优雅关停途中上报器把假 APPLIED 发给了云端；服务停后无自动重启
  （Restart=on-failure 对干净 stop 不生效），板子还失联了。
- 修复：
  - 脚本 `escape_service_cgroup()`：发现自己在服务 cgroup 内时先写
    `/sys/fs/cgroup/cgroup.procs` 迁到根 cgroup（cgroup v2），再动 systemctl；

# ---- 云端下发 OTA 回执（WEAKNET_OTA_RECEIPT）----------------------------------
# 云端经 pending_actions 下发升级时，上报器（weaknet-dbus-server）把 action
# 上下文写进回执文件（result=IN_PROGRESS）并通过环境变量把路径传进来。本脚本
# 是终态的唯一写入者：
#   - 成功转正后由 cmd_apply **显式**写 result=SUCCEEDED（唯一成功出口）
#   - EXIT 陷阱只写 FAILED：任何非正常走到成功出口的退出（fail/健康窗口回滚/
#     SIGTERM 连带杀死）一律按失败上报

OTA_RECEIPT="${WEAKNET_OTA_RECEIPT:-}"
ota_receipt_result() {  # $1 = SUCCEEDED | FAILED
    if [ -n "$OTA_RECEIPT" ] && [ -f "$OTA_RECEIPT" ]; then
        sed -i "s/\"result\":\"IN_PROGRESS\"/\"result\":\"$1\"/" "$OTA_RECEIPT" 2>/dev/null || true
    fi
}
ota_receipt_progress() {  # 重置 stall 计时（上报器按文件 mtime 判定升级进程死活）
    if [ -n "$OTA_RECEIPT" ] && [ -f "$OTA_RECEIPT" ]; then
        touch "$OTA_RECEIPT" 2>/dev/null || true
    fi
}
ota_receipt_on_exit() {

    # 把服务拉回来——否则 systemd 对干净 stop 不做自动重启，板子会一直失联。
    if [ "${OTA_SERVICE_STOPPED:-0}" = "1" ] && [ "$DRYRUN" != "1" ]; then
        if [ "$(systemctl is-active "$SERVICE" 2>/dev/null || true)" != "active" ]; then
            systemctl start "$SERVICE" 2>/dev/null || true
        fi
    fi
    # 走到这里且结果仍是 IN_PROGRESS = 没能抵达显式成功出口 → 按失败上报。
    # 不看退出码：SIGTERM 死亡时 $? 不可靠（见上方注释）。
    if [ -n "$OTA_RECEIPT" ] && [ -f "$OTA_RECEIPT" ] && \
       grep -q '"result":"IN_PROGRESS"' "$OTA_RECEIPT" 2>/dev/null; then
        ota_receipt_result FAILED
    fi
    return 0
